[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em261015&t=2&akid=2519%2E135344%2EOg2yfs)
---
Friends --
While my name is not on the ballot in this election, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support remains important to my success -- and the success of Democrats in a number of important races this election.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I ran for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate was also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions. This story is still playing out today with the Big Beautiful Bill and the healthcare crisis with increasing prices this fall.
Almost a decade later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
This next election is critical - taking back the House or Senate is the best way for Democrats to put a check on Donald Trump's power. I am one of the few members of Congress who won their election in a state or district also carried by Trump.
To be upfront: **I plan on spending the next two and a half weeks doing all I can to help elect Democrats running in tough races in Michigan and elsewhere -- like I've done for a number of candidates and state parties over the last several months. But that takes resources. So I am asking:**
[**Will you consider donating $24 or whatever you can to my campaign to help me hit the trail and campaign for Democrats in tough races. We can help them turn out the voters they need to win in these final weeks.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-26.79HKre&refcode=em261015&t=3&akid=2519%2E135344%2EOg2yfs)**

subject: The 250-foot monument to their arrogance
body:
Doug Burgum is building Trump’s Arch
Doug Burgum is building Trump’s Arch

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/D5Z_SXaLkIqiRsrEs0aXYw~~/AAUS1hA~/fXr5VGjiNXG7QE-jnPuPyBCV5YKQfh5x_8sLKOzXW_prSwTvy9csWn1k7PYBmgA-lusaGBJ-BhEmbZAa-mglCzqQUQeWDgB9w50GrSBEyyfcTRMJfwm1O1sdxwqgmPpx)

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: In Michigan today (health care)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Look around.
Today in America, there is more income and wealth inequality than at any time in our country's history. One third of Americans spend more than 30 percent of their income on housing and almost 800,000 people in America are homeless. Data centers are popping up across the country over public groundwater supplies with little transparency or oversight, compromising the drinking water and jacking up electricity bills. And we have a president who launched a reckless and unconstitutional war in Iran resulting in increased costs for almost everything in this country.
But there is one issue, maybe above all others, that is never far from people's minds because it impacts every single one of us and those we love in different ways.
That issue is health care.
Today and tomorrow I will be campaigning in Michigan to elect Dr. Abdul El-Sayed to the United States Senate and one of the major themes of our events, and of Abdul's campaign, is health care.
On this issue, the difference between Abdul and Mike Rogers could not be more clear.
Abdul El-Sayed believes that in the richest country in the history of the world, health care should be a guaranteed right for every man, woman and child.
Abdul was on the team that helped lay the groundwork for the law allowing Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices -- legislation passed in the Inflation Reduction Act that helped almost 2 million Michiganders.
Abdul understands that despite spending more per person on health care than any other developed country on the planet, people in the United States get worse outcomes -- including life expectancy.
Mike Rogers sees things differently. He supported Trump's cuts to Medicaid to fund tax breaks for some of the wealthiest people in this country. He voted against the Affordable Care Act and if elected to the Senate will continue that fight.
Needless to say, on the issue of health care Mike Rogers does not believe what we believe.
I have never understood how people can look at a health care system where tens of thousands of Americans die because they don't have insurance and think that is acceptable.
I have never understood how anyone can look at the hundreds of thousands of Americans who face financial ruin or declare bankruptcy because of medical bills and think that is ok.
In every other developed country on this planet people get sick -- just like we do. But in those countries -- as a right -- they are able to go to a doctor, get the medicine they need, and don't go bankrupt as a result.
There are a million reasons Abdul's race is important. Control of the Senate is on the line, we have a chance to put a check on Donald Trump's power over the final two years of his term, and Abdul is going to be a Senator we can all be proud of.
But if Abdul can win in Michigan it will send a message across the country that candidates who support health care as a guaranteed human right can win in some of the most watched "swing states" in this country.
There’s great value in that outcome.
Republicans know that too, which is why they are spending so much to defeat him.
That is why I am asking:
[ Can you please split a contribution between Abdul El-Sayed's campaign for the United States Senate in Michigan and my re-election to Congress in New York? ](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-abdul.jdIzox&refcode=em20261015-12450-P_FND_SPL_MIS&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=12450%2E2526796%2EE3X0TQ)

What better way to meet this moment than sending DOCTOR Abdul El-Sayed to the United States Senate?
Let's get it done.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

**[Donate](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-abdul.jdIzox&refcode=em20261015-12450-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=1&akid=12450%2E2526796%2EE3X0TQ)** | **[Merch](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/9251?utm_source=em-footer-20261015-12450-P_FND_SPL_MIS&t=2&akid=12450%2E2526796%2EE3X0TQ)**

| Hey friend, Juan here– Chris is an injured combat veteran, an AZ-06 resident, and a registered Democrat. When he reached the end of his rope, he called my office. We showed up and spoke up for him. I work for everyone in this district, so when someone needs help, their party registration doesn’t enter the equation. For the nearly 80,000 veterans I represent, that commitment means answering the call AND fighting for results in Congress. So far we have delivered: 🇺🇸 The Elizabeth Dole Act, now law, to improve veterans’ health care and benefits.
🇺🇸 Four veteran-focused bills passed through the House this Congress, including expanded GI Bill access through the VETS Opportunity Act.
🇺🇸 Bipartisan legislation to tackle the VA disability claims backlog.
🇺🇸 Work to remove barriers to homeownership for veterans, especially in rural communities. Behind every case is a person who deserves to be heard. Chris served our country, and when he needed someone in his corner, I was proud he trusted us.

clean_body: | | | | Hey friend, Juan here– Chris is an injured combat veteran, an AZ-06 resident, and a registered Democrat. When he reached the end of his rope, he called my office. We showed up and spoke up for him. I work for everyone in this district, so when someone needs help, their party registration doesn’t enter the equation. For the nearly 80,000 veterans I represent, that commitment means answering the call AND fighting for results in Congress. So far we have delivered: 🇺🇸 The Elizabeth Dole Act, now law, to improve veterans’ health care and benefits. 🇺🇸 Four veteran-focused bills passed through the House this Congress, including expanded GI Bill access through the VETS Opportunity Act. 🇺🇸 Bipartisan legislation to tackle the VA disability claims backlog. 🇺🇸 Work to remove barriers to homeownership for veterans, especially in rural communities. Behind every case is a person who deserves to be heard. Chris served our country, and when he needed someone in his corner, I was proud he trusted us. Peter, Roy Cooper here. I’m worried.
We’re 19 days out from the election, and today is the first day of in-person early voting here in North Carolina. Our fundraising is not where it needs to be this close to Election Day, so we’ve set a new goal to turn things around by tomorrow. [**_If you’re able to chip in today for the first time to help us get back on track, it would make a big impact and mean a lot to me._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1673&amount=5&t=9&akid=4578%2E124072%2EGDWpAc)
Here’s why we’re trying to raise $500,000 (I know – it’s ambitious) before tomorrow night:
North Carolina is where the fight for U.S. Senate control will be won or lost. Flipping this seat is a _must_ if we’re going to take back the majority, and that’s why the GOP is going all in to defeat me.
Republican super PACs have flooded this race with tens of millions to crush our momentum. President Trump has smeared my name to his millions of followers on social media. **And now, he’s coming to North Carolina _next week_ to hold a rally with my MAGA opponent.**
**If folks like you chip in and we hit our $500,000 goal, we’ll be able to keep up with the GOP and ensure this race stays competitive. If we don’t meet this goal, we won’t.**
[**_That’s why this is so important, Peter, so I have to ask: Will you give $5 or whatever amount you can spare today to help us reach our goal, flip North Carolina and take back the Senate majority?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1673&amount=5&t=10&akid=4578%2E124072%2EGDWpAc)

My name is Ron Barber.
#

[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261015-1-b&t=1&akid=11937%2E3935704%2EcGkwKX)
---
Friends,
My name is Ron Barber, and in 2011, I almost died alongside Gabby Giffords.
January 8, 2011, was a brisk Saturday morning in Tucson, when Congresswoman Gabby Giffords arrived for her “Congress on your Corner” event. I was serving as her district director.
It was supposed to be just another Saturday. But in just 19.6 seconds, six people lay dying and 13 others were wounded when a gunman opened fire in front of a Safeway supermarket.
The gunman shot Gabby in the head — leaving her with a condition called aphasia. I was shot in the face and in the leg. I was fading and almost died on the ground. But I thought about my family and tried to keep my eyes open until we made it to the trauma center that saved my life.
**Fifteen years later, Gabby and I still carry the scars of that terrible day._Some days are harder than others, but we can never stop fighting._**
Gun violence is a uniquely American crisis. Gun deaths have increased dramatically in the past two decades, becoming more common than car crashes. Far too often, we see disturbing new reports of politically motivated gun violence when we turn on the TV.
We have the tools to fix this epidemic, but we need our elected leaders to have the courage to take on the gun lobby and defend our democracy.
_That’s why I am reaching out personally:_ The midterms elections are in less than 20 days. GIFFORDS is working to defeat extremist candidates and help gun safety champions win in the most competitive races. But Gabby needs our support to reach more voters.
[**Please, pitch in $3 to help Gabby continue the fight to end gun violence. GIFFORDS PAC is working to stand up against the gun lobby’s extreme politics, and every donation makes a difference.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giff-em-q42026.PjNIJI&refcode=em261015-1-b&t=2&akid=11937%2E3935704%2EcGkwKX)

clean_body: My name is Ron Barber. Friends, My name is Ron Barber, and in 2011, I almost died alongside Gabby Giffords. January 8, 2011, was a brisk Saturday morning in Tucson, when Congresswoman Gabby Giffords arrived for her “Congress on your Corner” event. I was serving as her district director. It was supposed to be just another Saturday. But in just 19.6 seconds, six people lay dying and 13 others were wounded when a gunman opened fire in front of a Safeway supermarket. The gunman shot Gabby in the head — leaving her with a condition called aphasia. I was shot in the face and in the leg. I was fading and almost died on the ground. But I thought about my family and tried to keep my eyes open until we made it to the trauma center that saved my life. Fifteen years later, Gabby and I still carry the scars of that terrible day.Some days are harder than others, but we can never stop fighting. Gun violence is a uniquely American crisis. Gun deaths have increased dramatically in the past two decades, becoming more common than car crashes. Far too often, we see disturbing new reports of politically motivated gun violence when we turn on the TV. We have the tools to fix this epidemic, but we need our elected leaders to have the courage to take on the gun lobby and defend our democracy. That’s why I am reaching out personally: The midterms elections are in less than 20 days. body:
Defend Our Courts has been contacting thousands of voters in MI in recent days, and what we’re hearing from voters confirms this nightmare scenario is playing out in real time.

| Peter,
There is a critical race in Michigan that Democrats are on the verge of losing. No, not the U.S. Senate race. The Michigan Supreme Court race.
Two Democrat backed judges are up for reelection on the state's highest court this year, Justices Megan Cavanagh and Noah Hood.
Right now, Michigan's Supreme Court has a liberal majority. This critical swing state court is a crucial firewall against Trump's attempt to seize control over how states run elections. Losing this court would be a devastating blow for Democrats.
If Hood and Cavanagh lose their seats, MAGA will have an opening to seize control of the court as soon as 2028, an absolutely devastating blow that would lead to MAGA election rigging in the state.

| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00153t5loKtZJyJwpOn4JgJuJl5GjWOBGE_S4--M38HZi8IviYYfABWQrgNysNYU4PZm51mkOaHQ643X8NE7dy2lRQUHNvjjMsVKQi2dFhnINaAR5aQFhXRJcZm00lQG3xM_AKRDVGjLyuZp-94284Ey81vdbVVZz50snOCxLfOvovzvqnpjrEQk9QdrMvoBEE2V47ZjmmTphb_DqQ9rSjhPy7vtUTOXVBS&c=oLz5_KCPDmBXhFG6IdfxudB607YSP_ZJ2_XtcQkP08OIF3HRQDT9Hg==&ch=GsTYyva30GHxlP6RajuS_J-nwhwUHwOyj07nVI1f2WNOIu3O7Z-dsA==)

---
Here's the issue: the US Senate race is completely overshadowing the Supreme Court race.

**Hi Peter, I hope you’ll take a minute or two to read my story, but if you don’t have time,[please split a donation of $5 or $15 between Eric Sorensen and me today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141471196/653665649/1129906623?refcode=10.15.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTA3NTUwMi1hNmM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NT2u5b4RobtLo6vFRF8YxSxgp9h7axvcAX_CvHTGGJc=)** | [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141471197/653665650/1129906623?refcode=10.15.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTA3NTUwMi1hNmM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NT2u5b4RobtLo6vFRF8YxSxgp9h7axvcAX_CvHTGGJc=)
---
I come from a family of “doers,” and no one embodied that spirit more than my grandmother.
She went to work in a factory during World War II because, well, that’s what needed to be done. She really was, for all intents and purposes, a real-life Rosie the Riveter.
Growing up, I would go to my grandmother’s house for dinner every Sunday. I would sit and listen to her talk about our changing world and what she had been through. She would often say that contributing to the war effort was the time in her life when she felt like she was part of something bigger.
Around that kitchen table, I learned more about the power of public service than I ever could have in a classroom. I carried those lessons with me for years, even though politics was never something I imagined for myself. Running for office was nowhere on my radar.
**That changed when I became a mother.**
I was at the Massachusetts Office of Child Care Services, working on child care policy, when I realized my entire take-home salary was going toward child care.
I knew what it meant to be the last mom at pickup. To hope your child wouldn’t spike a fever and throw your entire schedule into chaos. To juggle work, family, and the impossible math so many parents face.
And I realized these weren’t just policy issues. This was my life. And it was the life of so many other families, too.
That’s when I knew I wanted to get involved — because my grandmother taught me that sometimes you step up simply because something needs to be done.
Peter, I’ve carried that mentality through every job I’ve had. And today, as the highest-ranking woman in the House, I’m proud to be at the forefront of the fight to make life more affordable for working families.
But the fight is far from being over.
House Democrats are working tirelessly to fight back against Donald Trump’s reckless economic agenda and work to pave a path for hardworking people to succeed — while the GOP majority is doing everything it can to stand in our way.
**We need to win back the House to keep fighting for families like ours — and we need people like you with us.**
[**My grandmother never waited around for someone else to step up. She saw what needed to be done, and did it. I’ve carried that lesson with me, and Peter, it’s our turn to do what needs to be done. If you’re ready to help Democrats take back the House, can I count on you to make a split donation between Eric and me today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141471199/653665651/1129906623?refcode=10.15.26-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjZTA3NTUwMi1hNmM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NT2u5b4RobtLo6vFRF8YxSxgp9h7axvcAX_CvHTGGJc=)

clean_body: | = Hi Peter, I hope you’ll take a minute or two to read my story, but if you don’t have time,= | = I come from a family of “doers,” and no one embodied that spirit more than my grandmother. She went to work in a factory during World War II because, well, that’s what needed to be done. She really was, for all intents and purposes, a real-life Rosie the Riveter. Growing up, I would go to my grandmother’s house for dinner every Sunday. I would sit and listen to her talk about our changing world and what she had been through. She would often say that contributing to the war effort was the time in her life when she felt like she was part of something bigger. Around that kitchen table, I learned more about the power of public service than I ever could have in a classroom. I carried those lessons with me for years, even though politics was never something I imagined for myself. Running for office was nowhere on my radar. That changed when I became a mother. I was at the Massachusetts Office of Child Care Services, working on child care policy, when I realized my entire take-home salary was going toward child care. I knew what it meant to be the last mom at pickup. To hope your child wouldn’t spike a fever and throw your entire schedule into chaos. To juggle work, family, and the impossible math so many parents face. And I realized these weren’t just policy issues. This was my life. And it was the life of so many other families, too. That’s when I knew I wanted to get involved — because my grandmother taught me that sometimes you step up simply because something needs to be done. Peter, I’ve carried that mentality through every job I’ve had. And today, as the highest-ranking woman in the House, I’m proud to be at the forefront of the fight to make life more affordable for working families. But the fight is far from being over. Friend,
---
Charlie said it best in the days leading up to President Trump's victory in 2024: _" I don't care about polls. __ __I don 't care about betting markets. __ __I don 't care about vibes. __ _ **_I care about how many ballots are in the box. _**_ __If we turnout, we win. __ _**_Do the work. " _** Do the work... Charlie knew there was no easy route to saving our country. He knew there were no shortcuts to victory. He wore a red band on his wrist every day -- a reminder of what it would take -- that read, _**" Be Better. Work Harder." **_ It wasn't just for motivation. Charlie lived by those four words, and he expected every one of us at Turning Point to live by them too. In fact, the standards that Charlie built this movement on still hang on the walls inside our headquarters:
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8bede9b2d7a1419fb574457296766dd8&_e=qumVr80nY2WQMW3RiK1A4BO4M3AwEqzX-EFEyz_4hjcYSvIXOA1JJ4RHR8je0945c53UoaCpgDV-PPE8U9BvKNrYVEJD8vOED7LJoXp9j1lREI2cxtJZDVYQcCrP2AnM3kNiEpqtLXN-hk8ihIGgQEpY3rCmqFg5wk1ogmDSNp1SYssyShr_IRNFeI03i3jJ8kEyom1bAuRYmDDsHCf3Up0naQYryFksPiY2CCtDgmBWqbC0ubzFNsB1jaPlcig-obHDvBw8pZ7XlxLwnIp338PGjHd8jJvbLPwnFgvNa4nFvz6zZtCCayUvSzChmB0Dy4K_8hkvKDEliI6w6LnknFOVDaPg9IzFD2eqfNjr271lrbrEANrkKNOpPxelxYeRwMVrK75XlYjsOK1Ale5uDeIp_hX292RKcXDSx80p9C3LGTLp_kMlRt2CV6mY1aVcz0q2MC_ij01gXO1IJxJjbYZbGgs1zQqpN9X5roKEBhqmcPIpvJI5d95g-ZdVmPpLinnSeW1OLSsMscvh98hRY_Adw0aFryAUsKBZfGkWpcsw5xX2EKwHtab5DvCemL1qG8ahJgzS05TB8WR6LKxpBUCsLOS_pPpLMf4c6UYLmgravv9712RDnT2SSTEGZFe7-kTtKmm4NwNyQw1ZlGqTxBqg42zM0DJbjH-eY79FIORP2embrmB6fOtQdfrQBGU0IhDbbvowGSVOaeZXAqeCrLFElhxz_n-yYzgDYvpxLcQ%3D)
---
Those banners were never meant just for the people on our staff. Charlie meant them for anyone who ever said they'd fight for this country. And that includes patriots like you, Friend. Because right now, the midterms are coming down to the wire. _Nearly every battleground state or district? _ Tied. A dead heat. Within the margin of error. **And just as Charlie said... when it 's that close, only one thing matters: How. Many. Ballots. Are. In. The. Box. ** That's why our ballot chasing teams are working around the clock in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire to beat the Communist Left this November.
---
[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8bede9b2d7a1419fb574457296766dd8&_e=qumVr80nY2WQMW3RiK1A4BO4M3AwEqzX-EFEyz_4hjcYSvIXOA1JJ4RHR8je0945c53UoaCpgDV-PPE8U9BvKNrYVEJD8vOED7LJoXp9j1lREI2cxtJZDVYQcCrP2AnM3kNiEpqtLXN-hk8ihIGgQEpY3rCmqFg5wk1ogmDSNp1SYssyShr_IRNFeI03i3jJ8kEyom1bAuRYmDDsHCf3Up0naQYryFksPiY2CCtDgmBWqbC0ubzFNsB1jaPlcig-y8VbJjBlgRyiXoZxsGEAMSsp4s-KXIWuOpdUuKGHVsRCmTPF9BetDXzGJ2Q9vSdrdGDoaBaypjVJD63aWm3bWLaTfskGOypUceA_vBbYhY5NAdStQWj-SrcDvDiws8rIGonAq6_-5TBH_0Uf2MBMreM3bY_wM2CdZDXWC1xscZfcrGe_tFsaq9cqptfLki51VBZv6M2xvyXf52PTS1_qNhFcknM6_AaeGMg6rh2qP4ilDgnhDyjNNmiSSuMxR-DMg_N3j0MrlUpll4y4uzffiz4JwJVQIQr5r2rdQqgJok8JhmX-BV-geC1gpg2EeeVFbT6OopUpGgTmD9RF3n3blhhCIvjzoBuFgpBzAc68h25nl2cSz4i4_J8tRdA6u8rcf7JV_8hqo55bdQ0l7RgLaUhURJqskyXBtO4551nmi96HKsvhJfLBQkWD8o75IpJZAMJ5bgTn_SzyME2gAvP8Xy7EQZbzgPPAvxIZDlR2n4A%3D)

They're out knocking doors, making phone calls, registering voters, training new volunteers, and once voting opens, they'll chase down every last ballot they can. But as hard as they're working, we still don't have enough of them. And we're running out of time to get new ballot chasers and volunteers trained and into the field before voting begins. _So here 's the deal, Friend... _ **We simply need to get more ballot chasers sponsored for our FINAL Chase the Vote trainings. ** **And every $50 you give today to Turning Point Action helps train and deploy ONE more ballot chaser in a battleground state. ** That ballot chaser has one goal: chase down 10 ballots a day, minimum, every day voting is open. If you do the math, your fifty bucks means hundreds of conservative ballots in the box on Election Day -- from voters who would've stayed home otherwise and handed the Left the win. If you want to beat the Left this November, you won't find a better return on a political donation anywhere else in America. **[Make your gift here to sponsor a trained ballot chaser and put them in the field immediately.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8bede9b2d7a1419fb574457296766dd8&_e=qumVr80nY2WQMW3RiK1A4BO4M3AwEqzX-EFEyz_4hjcYSvIXOA1JJ4RHR8je0945c53UoaCpgDV-PPE8U9BvKNrYVEJD8vOED7LJoXp9j1lREI2cxtJZDVYQcCrP2AnM3kNiEpqtLXN-hk8ihIGgQEpY3rCmqFg5wk1ogmDSNp1SYssyShr_IRNFeI03i3jJ8kEyom1bAuRYmDDsHCf3Up0naQYryFksPiY2CCtDgmBWqbC0ubzFNsB1jaPlcig-fAohbyudOJg7paGs5Xc04Utf_6faJJsAVlY7NIVQs8-0_kdFmROBzAD4Tp7D92sZ0-YRBPUCYfvSIfv7MezTb1EGZiMD2Jcw5-SMH0bIw6IPGT9equhPvPXXvREqSUcYdrijZMBqPV383AKmSkes2bK_eX1wHw-fY7-klQPRRDDCZT-Cp9aF-YtLJCWWpZegZ8SoaUm370BuLDuNOwxYRzFVSt7hjlPbP40W0PltAnO6UgNlsB1PbiIJnbF4jEMP5vNj0hntuCn5Q_VYC4t_ABAgC97VnwkT-rQm9ztNv7CjcimzF3p8hXiUZdJ3zQPzzbdp4hZSolyZLO3feaNv0yVCQibmthe8MYBGyhfmsUfjUC9XcZ4xTigUJ66UXkIy_LPlXTUZ07L5HKufnLuhlT2wDUooh62MUe6t6MzvwUi2yRHBh-wJhc3wPUdDmt4oXw9Vho2wjLk2u7imx2lK6SCeCOt7b_89nMdB0rKbxSM%3D)**

**THURSDAY, OCTOBER 15, 2026**
Our Nigerian dwarf herd numbers thirty to forty. When they move toward new feeding grounds, their order is a sight to see. The eldest females lead. The Legacy group follows, mothers calling the little ones into line with rhythmic _mah, mah_. Napoleon, our oldest, takes the rearguard, with Absalom now alongside him. As the herd browses, Napoleon rests in the shade. The kids gather near him, nudging him--and he them--or playing beneath his watchful gaze.
Each age group contributes differently to the herd.
For us, conscience adds weight: keeping a principle may cost us the visible win. The world may never recognize what we preserve by refusing to bend, or count its cost.
Yet these silent wins speak of great character.
**Pause.**
**Breathe.**
**Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**

Peter, Hardworking Americans overpay on taxes every single year. Not because they cheated or cut corners. Because nobody ever sat down with them and showed them how the tax code actually works. Buried in there are strategies that are 100% legal and used every day by people who plan their taxes instead of just filing them. Same rules. Different playbook. If you catch Bill Spadea’s morning drive show on 101.5, you may have already heard him talk about us. Tru-Fit Tax is the company Bill recommends when people ask him how to stop overpaying. subject: Peter, I saved your spot
body:

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |
Peter, did you get my email the other day?
I looked over our Victory Captain list this morning, and I didn't see your name yet.
I know how busy life gets, so I wanted to make sure my invitation didn't slip past you.
With less than 20 days to go, there's no time to waste. The people who step up now will decide how this race ends. _**And I want you in that group.**_
Will you take ten seconds right now to accept your Victory Captain role?
[**ACCEPT MY VICTORY CAPTAIN ROLE >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/bsH3hKrVC6D?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Saying yes means you're ready to stand with me through Election Day, helping your friends and neighbors get to the polls and making sure Central New York hears our message loud and clear.
**I'd be honored to add your name today, Peter.**
Kailee
\-------------------- FORWARDED MESSAGE --------------------To: dpwillis67@gmail.comFrom: Kailee

---
| |
Peter,
We are now 21 days away from Election Day.
When I started this campaign, I said it would be built from the ground up by the people of Central New York. You've been part of that from the start, and I'm grateful.
**But these final weeks are when races like ours are won or lost.**
Every conversation with a neighbor, every reminder to a friend, and every yard sign in a front lawn matters more now than at any point in this campaign.
That is why I'm asking you to become an official VICTORY CAPTAIN for Kailee Buller for Congress.
[**YES, I'LL BE A VICTORY CAPTAIN >>**](https://us.list-manage.com/daE5kJMDsw8?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)
Here's what being a Victory Captain means...
Victory Captains are the people I'll count on most in the home stretch. You'll be the first to hear our closing plan, the first to get our final campaign updates, and the person your friends and family turn to when they want to know what's really at stake in this race.
_**We'll be counting on you to help make sure the people in your life have a plan to vote, to let us know who could use a yard sign, and to keep us in touch with what's happening in your corner of NY-22.**_
_**You'll be the reason voters who might have stayed home show up instead.**_
I'm running to lower costs, protect our communities, defend our farmers and small businesses, and make Central New York a place where our kids can build their futures. And I need people like you standing with me now, more than ever.
[ _So, Peter, will you be there?_](https://us.list-manage.com/30Y9UTyjX37?e=7e42b80a6c&c2id=65ca27defa2b2ff4fbda44443b52d843)

The clock is running, and I want my strongest supporters in place before the final push begins.
Thank you for being on this team. Let's finish this together.
Kailee BullerRepublican Candidate for Congress, NY-22

It's a simple question: "Did Joe Biden win the 2020 election?" And yet, again and again, Republican candidates have essentially gagged themselves in front of the nation, because they are terrified that an honest, straightforward "yes" will mean they will incur the wrath of Trump.

And just like that, it happened again. During his October 13 debate with Senator Jon Ossoff, Republican Senate candidate Mike Collins was asked whether Joe Biden legitimately won the 2020 presidential election. And he wouldn't give a straight answer. **Instead, he ignored the actual question, and kept mumbling that Biden became president, and other non-answers.**

subject: Here's what's at stake in Michigan, Ohio, Iowa, and Kansas:
body:
We can win in all of these races, Derek, but not without your help. [ ](https://ak.democrats.org/go/87341?t=1&akid=9884%2E22930333%2EoZcFO4)
---
Derek, Election Day is in less than one month. Take a look at our calendar: [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20261015_9884_fr&amount=7&refcode2=9884_22930333_oZcFO4&akid=9884%2E22930333%2EoZcFO4) Here’s what’s at stake: **In Michigan,** if Democrats hold this seat this fall, that will mean fewer seats we need to flip to regain the Senate majority. This race is going to be _close_ , and ballots are being filled out across the state _as we speak_. **In Ohio,** we have a real shot at flipping JD Vance’s old Senate seat. Winning in Ohio would bring us one step closer to the four seats we need to flip for a Democratic Senate majority. **In Iowa,** recent polling has the race _within reach_. Winning this race would mean flipping a seat that’s been in Republican hands for _years_. **In Kansas,** Republicans are scrambling to pour millions of dollars into attack ads. That’s because new polling shows the Senate race is _tied in Kansas._ If we won that seat, it would be held by a Democrat for the first time in **_nearly 100 years._** We can win in _all_ of these races, Derek, [**but not without your help.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-2026-gfr?amount=7&refcode=em_20261015_9884_fr&refcode2=9884_22930333_oZcFO4&akid=9884%2E22930333%2EoZcFO4) **Your gift to the DNC will not directly fund any specific candidate, but it WILL fuel our national midterm operation — helping us expand our digital operations, reach more voters, and support 10,000+ campaigns that rely on our tech and data infrastructure. name: Chad Bianco
subject: Voters Elect the Sheriff. Not activist committees.
body:
Your support stops this.

| | | | | |
---
| |

Friends,
The Riverside County Board of Supervisors has created an ad hoc committee to study new oversight options for the Sheriff’s Department, led by Supervisors Jose Medina and Karen Spiegel.
**Whether you agree with this or not** , the voters don’t get to have a say. They are making that decision for you.
**My position is clear** : the department already operates under extensive accountability—budget oversight by the Board, state inspections, the District Attorney, the Department of Justice, and more, making this committee **unnecessary**.
**Far-left activists are once again pressuring the Board** to create extra roadblocks to public safety. This is the same fight we have seen in Los Angeles County. In 2016, they imposed an ad hoc committee that has since caused division among the community and the department, **wasted taxpayer dollars** , enriched a lot of consultants and produced no meaningful improvement to public safety.
---
| | | | | [Support Bianco](https://us.list-manage.com/X8dB0GzpodP?e=1facf02470&c2id=205919520b3860dafbe9b9f5dda2019d)
---
| |
**Voters elect the Sheriff**. They do not elect activist committees or outside special interests that want ongoing influence over the day-to-day law enforcement decisions that keep our communities safe. The county currently operates on a deficit worth tens of millions, yet **my department operates within budget** because I believe government should respect the people’s tax dollars.
**Oversight committees have normally been voted on by the people** , as seen in San Francisco County. I only wish the Board of Supervisors weren’t going around the voters of Riverside for their own political agenda.
Previous attacks on my record as Sheriff have been answered by a strong grassroots response from everyday people like you.**This is just another one**.
Thank you for standing with law enforcement and with the voters who elected me twice.

Sheriff Chad Bianco
Riverside County

Catholic theology professor Jody Hunt **[pushed back during a CNN town hall](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea32b3f-4c0f-49b6-bade-5aafa3a42036?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Texas Senate candidate James Talarico claimed "the Bible is silent on the issue of abortion," citing the Ten Commandments' prohibition on killing and saying Catholics take offense at that characterization.
## [Watch:](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea32b3f-4c0f-49b6-bade-5aafa3a42036?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* **Talarico called abortion a "public health problem" rather than a moral one, **acknowledging he and Hunt reach different conclusions while insisting both can be Christians with differing views on the issue.
* **Separately, Christian business owner Sarah Gardner challenged Talarico over past comments calling God "nonbinary,"** which he defended as "provocative" but theologically uncontroversial, while affirming Jesus as "the way, the truth, and the life" -- a shift from a 2023 sermon in which he said God is not exclusively Christian.

* * *
# **El-Sayed clashes with NBC reporter over sister 's Muslim Brotherhood claims**
Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed dismissed social media posts from his sister Eman Abdelhadi that indicate his family has **[long standing ties to Egypt's Muslim Brotherhood ](https://substack.com/redirect/01998195-18cf-4fda-9bc2-d5ade62e094b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**as "hearsay", including that his mother was active in the group in the 1970s and relatives were jailed over Brotherhood connections.
[| | | | | TheBlaze
---
@theblaze
NBC brings receipts and PRESSES Abdul El-Sayed on his family's connections to the Muslim Brotherhood: "When people ask you a question, they do expect the truth."
| 12:47 AM * Oct 15, 2026 * 6.86K Views7 Replies * 28 Reposts * 95 Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/91b2f729-70e0-46fd-8262-5b89e22f3060?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **During a tense NBC interview, El-Sayed denied personal knowledge of such ties** despite maintaining close contact with his mother and sister over the years, including serving as his sister's wedding guardian and previously claiming dual Egyptian citizenship, a statement his campaign now calls an error.
* **El-Sayed has faced additional scrutiny over a 2012 letter urging Egypt 's Brotherhood government to "purge" media and police,** past defense of a friend jailed for funding the group, and his father-in-law's leadership role in an organization federal prosecutors have linked to the Brotherhood.

* * *
# **Ilhan Omar 's cellphone and passport seized in deportation investigation **
Federal agents seized Rep. Ilhan Omar's cellphone, notebooks, computers, and passport **[during Monday's home search,](https://substack.com/redirect/62daaeca-5b07-4db1-aebb-04d6d0793fe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** part of separate probes examining alleged immigration fraud in Minnesota and the finances of Omar and her husband Tim Mynett under the DC US Attorney's office, with the immigration investigation reportedly aimed at eventual denaturalization and deportation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/62daaeca-5b07-4db1-aebb-04d6d0793fe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The probe centers on whether Omar misrepresented her age to qualify for derivative citizenship through her father in 2000;** some records list her birth year as 1981, which would have made her too old for the minor exemption, though her staff later pushed to officially record it as 1982.
* **Omar 's office denies wrongdoing,** calling the investigation politically motivated. More than a dozen grand jury subpoenas have been issued to family members, including her sister. Trump denied involvement in the probe while calling Omar "totally crooked."

# Trump says no to firing squad execution broadcast
President Trump reversed Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth's plan to livestream Nidal Hasan's Dec. 3 firing-squad execution, saying while it might deter future attacks, many people would prefer not to watch. **[The execution will still proceed](https://substack.com/redirect/83a27872-bb1a-4cc6-a9aa-4eea2a59b625?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as scheduled, with victims' families able to view it in person.
[| | | | | Fox News
---
@FoxNews
BREAKING: Trump rules out livestream for Fort Hood attacker Nidal Hasan's firing squad execution
| 2:12 PM * Oct 15, 2026 * 215K Views270 Replies * 203 Reposts * 1.74K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/395a78d9-564a-4aa2-a968-b8b4b7ade57b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **President Trump:** "He will die, as scheduled, by firing squad, but this event will not be streamed,..."
* **Hasan was sentenced to death in 2013 for killing 13 people and wounding 32 others at Fort Hood in 2009.** The livestream plan drew bipartisan pushback, including from Vice President JD Vance and House Speaker Mike Johnson, who raised concerns about reinforcing Hasan's desire for martyrdom and inspiring future extremist recruitment.
* **The military hasn 't carried out an execution since 1961** and hasn't used a firing squad since 1945, when it executed a soldier for desertion during World War II.

* * *
# **Report: Most UK jobs since 2014 went to foreign workers, welfare costs soar**
A Centre for Social Justice report found that since 2014, only 734,000 new UK jobs went to British citizens, **[compared to nearly 3 million taken by immigrants](https://substack.com/redirect/e3a20400-0fe2-413b-a16b-3656a119248d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** -- mostly from outside Europe -- with the shift accelerating after Brexit and pandemic-era immigration policy changes under Boris Johnson.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3a20400-0fe2-413b-a16b-3656a119248d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The report found welfare dependency rose alongside migrant employment,** with 2.3 million more Britons receiving out-of-work benefits since 2020, pushing the UK's total welfare bill to £136 billion this year -- up £50 billion since 2019-20.
* **Reform UK 's Richard Tice blamed both major parties for enabling an "open-borders, low-wage" model,** with the party pledging to cut £50 billion in annual welfare spending by barring foreign nationals from benefits and scrapping permanent residency status for long-term migrants.

# Yemen
* **Saudi-led coalition claims missile intercepted over holy city; Ansarallah denies launching attack:** The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen [claimed](https://substack.com/redirect/e566632e-e768-48f2-8e9e-4bab62c14e06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday that its forces intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile over the Medina region of Saudi Arabia, according to the coalition spokesperson.
* Ansarallah said Yemeni forces had not carried out any attacks against Saudi territory on Thursday. A spokesperson described Saudi Arabia's allegation of an attempted strike on the Islamic holy city as a "great and blatant fabrication."
* **Ansarallah claims direct hit on Saudi fighter jet:** A Saudi Typhoon fighter jet was [targeted](https://substack.com/redirect/cc7deb01-d7c2-4633-89d6-67c2c95bce9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with a surface-to-air missile over Saada governorate in northern Yemen, Ansarallah forces claimed. The aircraft had taken off from Taif Air Base in Saudi Arabia and sustained a direct hit, leaving it at risk of crashing. The claim has not been independently verified.
* **EU-Gulf summit postponed:** A summit of European Union and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) leaders scheduled for next week in Riyadh was [postponed](https://substack.com/redirect/31108847-a0f6-4116-ba90-1740af6a876b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) following Ansarallah attacks on Saudi Arabia and the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport.
* The decision was made to ensure the safety of participating delegations, the GCC Secretary-General announced Thursday. A new date will be announced later, the European Council said, reaffirming its commitment to strengthening ties with Gulf states.
* Gulf states hope the summit will advance efforts towards Schengen visa exemptions. Bulgaria is also pushing for a railway corridor that can transport Saudi oil to Europe through Syria, Turkey, and Bulgaria, bypassing the blockaded Strait of Hormuz.
* **UN urges Ansarallah to release 71 detained staff members in Yemen:** The United Nations [called](https://substack.com/redirect/1775bd52-3916-4f94-a840-b33cba179261?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Ansarallah to release all detained personnel from the UN, NGOs, civil society organizations and diplomatic missions, following the release of UN staff member Sami Al-Kalabi, who had been held in Sana'a since 2024. A total of 71 UN staff members remain in Ansarallah detention, many without charge or trial.
* Ansarallah has accused some detained UN and humanitarian workers of espionage and collaboration with the U.S. and Israel. It has not provided evidence for those accusations.
* Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch have repeatedly called for Ansarallah to release "the dozens of arbitrarily detained members of Yemen's civil society and UN staff," and have documented Ansarallah's use of torture and abuse in its detention facilities.

# Palestine
* **Israel suspends commercial goods from entering Gaza:** Israel has [suspended](https://substack.com/redirect/85a8d4f2-4477-4fd7-b28b-b6277fe7d51f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the entry of private-sector goods into Gaza over allegations that Hamas threatened and coerced merchants, according to Nickolay Mladenov, High Representative President Donald Trump's "Board of Peace."
* The decision further restricts essential supplies for more than two million Palestinians in the devastated enclave. Gaza relies on the entry of a combination of humanitarian aid and commercial goods that have both been subjected to heavy Israeli restrictions.
* Mladenov said he received a letter from Israel's Coordinator of Government Activities in the Territories informing him of the suspension. He condemned the alleged intimidation of merchants as "unacceptable" but did not call on Israel to reverse the decision or specify when commercial deliveries might resume.
* Hunger in Gaza remains at crisis levels following a full-blown famine declared in the summer, according to the world's leading authority on food insecurity, the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification.
* **Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian near school in Gaza City:** A Palestinian was killed and several others were wounded by an Israeli drone [strike](https://substack.com/redirect/ee04ef65-bb22-439b-baf9-192e0f62c7db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) near the Ibad Al-Rahman School, northwest of Gaza City, on Thursday, according to WAFA.
* Over the past 24 hours, four Palestinians were killed and nine injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023, is now 74,396 killed, with 175,449 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,505 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,332, while 838 bodies have been recovered.
* **Israel 's closure of Rafah blocks medical evacuations from Gaza for second week:** Israel has kept the Rafah border crossing closed for a second consecutive week, preventing sick and wounded Palestinians from leaving Gaza for medical treatment abroad, Gaza's Health Ministry said Thursday.
* Medical-leave waitlists for ailing Palestinians are growing daily, as peoples' needs far exceed the capacity of Gaza's devastated and besieged hospitals to accommodate patients or provide even minimum levels of treatment, the ministry said.
* **Settlers attack Palestinians, damage farmland, and establish new outpost across the occupied West Bank:**
* **Ramallah:** Israeli settlers [attacked](https://substack.com/redirect/aed8b43b-c4d2-4254-8e28-c5ccc85aeb84?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Palestinian olive pickers in Burqa village, east of Ramallah, on Thursday, WAFA reported. Israeli forces blocked the village entrance, obstructing an ambulance for several hours.
* **Hebron:** Settlers [intercepted](https://substack.com/redirect/25fa3891-4378-4de3-b3f0-a58a776a212a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) vehicles carrying Palestinian Medical Relief Society teams and attempted to prevent them from reaching Khirbet Al-Majaz, in Masafer Yatta, to provide medical care. In Beit Ummar, north of Hebron, settlers destroyed crops and cut irrigation pipes belonging to a Palestinian farmer.
* **Salfit:** Settlers [established](https://substack.com/redirect/11bf2ce8-5bd2-4706-84b5-bff33e847479?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a new pastoral settlement outpost in Wadi Yasuf, east of Salfit, erecting tents on Palestinian land.
* **Nablus:** Settlers [cut](https://substack.com/redirect/6f4537fd-dc8b-48d5-8d68-ea75c35a59cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) electricity poles connected to a home in Burin, south of Nablus. The home, located near the Yitzhar settlement, has been repeatedly targeted by settlers.
* **Israel has detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023, with 350 still confined:** Israeli forces have detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023, with 350 currently held in "harsh conditions," according to a report from the Palestinian Prisoner's Society.
* Palestinian children face abuses ranging from "intimidation and arrest" to "torture, starvation and denial of healthcare," the group said.

* **Israeli guards shoot Palestinian prisoners with rubber bullets at close range:** Israeli prison guards have shot rubber bullets at Palestinian inmates at close range, two Israeli rights groups warned, [according](https://substack.com/redirect/346073f7-3fbb-4ecd-8ffd-0b6dcd626e15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to AP. The two groups documented nearly two dozen, most of which have occurred since last fall, compared to only a handful of incidents documented over the prior decade.
* According to the groups Physicians for Human Rights Israel and the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel, prisoners have been struck by rubber bullets in the legs, knees, stomach and pelvic area, according to the reports, with many not being treated for their injuries.
* The Israel Prison Service's legal adviser, in response to a letter from rights groups, said it saw no reason to stop using rubber bullets in "measured" and "appropriate" ways.

# Iran
* **U.S. military develops plans to strike Iranian energy and nuclear sites with "mother of all bombs," CNN reports:** The U.S. military [developed](https://substack.com/redirect/e7e025b0-0d1c-49a3-b76b-a7f79394d032?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new strike plans that include deploying the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), the largest non-nuclear bomb in its arsenal, against Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear facilities, should President Donald Trump order renewed attacks before or after the November midterm elections, according to CNN.
* Officials questioned whether the MOAB could destroy deeply buried nuclear facilities. The bomb is designed primarily for massive surface-level destruction rather than deep penetration.
* Some military planners described potential strikes as a "fireworks show" intended to give Trump a symbolic victory and a way out of the war. Others suggested the MOAB could serve as a psychological weapon to pressure Tehran to make a deal.
* At a rally in Arizona, Trump claimed that the war on Iran would end "very soon" and predicted fuel prices would fall once the fighting stopped. "I knew gasoline would go high, but I had no idea," he said. "I thought it was going to go much higher, to be honest with you."
* **CENTCOM says it destroyed Iranian-linked surveillance vessel in Gulf of Oman:** U.S. forces [destroyed](https://substack.com/redirect/22b47a40-6bbd-40ed-aa69-60d3aaae35de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) an Iranian-affiliated dhow in the Gulf of Oman on October 6, claiming the vessel was conducting surveillance and targeting U.S. Navy warships, according to U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM).
* At least 10 ships have been attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz since Sunday, the highest number over such a period since the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran began. Six vessels were attacked Sunday and four Tuesday, while two sailors are reportedly missing and a cargo ship was reportedly sunk by an Iranian naval mine.
* **Iran must fight and negotiate simultaneously to deter future U.S. attacks, parliament speaker says:** Iran must combine military action with diplomacy to establish lasting deterrence, as neither negotiations nor military confrontation alone can guarantee the country's security, Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf [said](https://substack.com/redirect/ffc560d2-f22b-44fc-8a88-17f2dd227595?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Wednesday.
* Ghalibaf argued that Washington's pursuit of regional dominance meant military pressure alone would not force it to abandon its objectives. "Whenever we achieve a military victory on the battlefield, we must also turn that victory into a political victory, consolidate it and turn it into a document of defeat for the enemy," he said.
* **Iran vows further crackdown on Starlink:** Iranian authorities pledged to intensify efforts to disrupt Elon Musk's Starlink satellite internet service, describing it as a "tool of war." "It is a tool used for command and control by the enemy, for espionage and information gathering," the secretary of Iran's Supreme National Cyberspace Council said.
* Iran has imposed two prolonged internet shutdowns this year, including an 88-day blackout following the start of the U.S.-Israeli war in February.

# Lebanon
* **Israeli strikes wound two, including four-year-old, in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire:** Israeli forces [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/a71e34af-6269-443c-b08f-ed0eeb362631?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the town of Kfar Tebnit in the Nabatieh district on Thursday, while artillery shelling targeted Mansouri and Majdal Zoun in the Tyre (Sour) district, according to Lebanon's National News Agency.
* Israeli troops [ordered](https://substack.com/redirect/4df2a924-ca87-410c-b8dc-535185e8ee09?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Lebanese farmers from Kfar Shouba to leave the Azrael and Bastara areas while they were harvesting olives.
* Two people, including a four-year-old, were [wounded](https://substack.com/redirect/a1c9deef-d776-4ba6-a534-72690120d6b0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in an Israeli airstrike on Hadatha, Bint Jbeil on Wednesday.
* **Hezbollah claims ownership of explosives seized in eastern Lebanon:** Hezbollah MP Hassan Fadlallah [confirmed](https://substack.com/redirect/83860453-5f37-4793-baae-be12dfb0be15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday that a vehicle intercepted by Lebanese authorities at the Dahr Al-Baydar checkpoint in eastern Lebanon belonged to the group and was carrying materials used to fight Israeli forces. He demanded the release of those detained and the return of the vehicle and its contents, saying the explosives, including C-4, were intended exclusively for use against Israel.
* Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam pledged Monday to hold accountable those responsible for transporting the explosives toward Beirut, expressing concern that C-4 had been used in political assassinations in Lebanon's recent history.
* Fadlallah rejected the suggestion of a connection to assassinations, accusing the government of fueling internal divisions and serving Israeli and American interests.

# U.S. News
* **The U.S. is sending hundreds of troops to Latin America to fight drug traffickers:** The Pentagon is [sending](https://substack.com/redirect/e231e825-5b9c-434b-874e-cf05475480d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a 600-soldier battalion from the 10th Mountain Division to train and exercise with local forces in Latin America, U.S. military officials told the New York Times on Wednesday.
* The first elements are deploying to a new jungle training facility in Panama. They will later train with forces in Colombia, taking part in the Southern Vanguard exercise later this month, and Honduras. They could also provide security for U.S. helicopters in raids against alleged traffickers.
* Gen. **Francis Donovan** , head of Southern Command, has said the U.S. plans to expand from boat strikes to land strikes against "narco-terrorists," and only a handful of countries, including Colombia and Honduras, have agreed to joint operations on their soil.
* **WSJ: Ilhan Omar investigation aims to strip her citizenship and deport her** : The Trump administration's probe of Rep. **Ilhan Omar** (D-Minn.) is aimed at building a case to revoke her U.S. citizenship and ultimately deport her, the Wall Street Journal [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/9b18c137-9ecf-4fb7-81f0-8027532a5d77?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Agents searched her Washington home early Monday, taking her cellphone, notebooks, personal computers, and passport.
* At the center of the investigation is whether Omar or her father altered her age on her citizenship application to show 17 rather than 18, which would have qualified her automatically through his naturalization in 2000. More than a dozen subpoenas seek testimony before a Minnesota grand jury about the family's immigration paperwork.
* Homeland Security Investigations examined a similar tip under Biden and declined to proceed for lack of evidence of fraud.
* **Watchdog group sues to bar Jared Kushner from acting as envoy without Senate confirmation or financial disclosures** : Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/859664ed-f45c-4ba7-94c1-928d5766e551?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) suit against special envoy **Jared Kushner** and the White House, arguing he "holds a continuing position and wields significant government authority" while running Affinity Partners, a Miami investment firm with over $6 billion under management, about 99% of it owned by foreign investors, mostly from the Gulf states.
* CREW asks the court to block the Trump administration from continuing his role until the Senate confirms him and he files all financial disclosures.
* **Illinois teen arrested over alleged mass shooting plot possibly targeting a Hindu temple** : Police from the town of Palatine, Illinois, [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/d05ae987-5cc4-4937-8bd1-fe3a90e6fe9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 19-year-old **Alexandros Paporakis** on Sunday. Detectives who searched his home recovered a rifle, multiple loaded magazines, hundreds of rounds of ammunition, and a tactical vest with body armor and a patch bearing white supremacist imagery. They also found a document titled "Why I fought: A.K.A.: (Aurora Shooter's Manifesto)" expressing white supremacist views and referencing violence toward South Asians, specifically Indians. Authorities are investigating whether he planned to attack a Hindu temple in Aurora, about 40 miles southwest of Palatine.
* **ICE rejects GAO recommendation for automatic body cameras** : A Government Accountability Office [report](https://substack.com/redirect/1a4d20d0-d1d4-4acb-99a7-e4ff4cb7ba64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) recommended ICE use "automated camera activation" for unplanned use-of-force incidents, such as when an officer draws a weapon or turns on a siren. DHS rejected it, saying automatic activation could cause "the unauthorized recording of sensitive interactions with informants or victims."
* DHS told GAO all ICE offices had received cameras by Aug. 5, but on Wednesday said required training was still ongoing and should finish "soon." GAO also found officers at ICE and CBP were confused about when to activate cameras, such as during vehicle searches or detainee transport, and that one ICE office hadn't begun using them even after training.
* **FTC sends civil subpoenas to OpenAI, Anthropic over consumer harms** : The Federal Trade Commission is [demanding](https://substack.com/redirect/8beef65b-7132-4414-a122-b26837c6ca54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) documents on security incidents and safeguarding practices, plus marketing materials and privacy policies, from Anthropic and Open AI, in a probe focused on potential consumer protection violations, Axios reports. Demands to third-party AI organizations will follow later, Axios reported, and the FTC plans to compel top AI executives to testify.
* **Teamsters leader demands GOP super PAC pull Maine Senate ad that misattributes quote about Troy Jackson** : Lawyers for **Gregory Floyd** , president of New York's Teamsters Local 237, [sent](https://substack.com/redirect/d1bf5823-3d00-474f-9899-c979fd25a3d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Senate Leadership Fund a cease-and-desist letter, first obtained by NBC News, over an ad attacking Maine Democratic Senate candidate **Troy Jackson** 's "Medicare for All" support. The ad's caption reads "Troy Jackson's 'plan is a disaster,'" attributed to Floyd. Floyd says he never commented on Jackson's plan--his comment was about a 2019 version by presidential candidate **Elizabeth Warren** --and that the ad conveys a "false and defamatory" message.
* **Social Security benefits to rise 3.6% in 2027, an average of $75 a month** : The Social Security Administration announced a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027, raising retirement benefits by an average of $75 a month. Nearly 72 million Social Security beneficiaries will see higher payments starting in January, and about 7.3 million SSI recipients will see increases starting December 31, 2026. It follows September inflation of 3.7%, up from 3.4% in August and the highest since a three-year peak of 4.2% in May.

# Other International News
* **Five sentenced by Syrian court over mass sectarian violence:** Two people were sentenced to death and three others to prison terms by a Syrian court on Thursday over their roles in a campaign of sectarian violence last year in the Alawite region of coastal Syria.
* In March 2025, an uprising by elements of the former Assad regime was followed by a much larger and violent backlash by militias and security forces affiliated with the current Syrian government that spiraled into widespread sectarian violence that killed over 1,500 people. Read Drop Site's coverage of the massacre [here](https://substack.com/redirect/aa93d708-86d4-410a-ba00-a57d6539b171?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* Separately, Syrian intelligence officials [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/beab3a58-f2f9-4c95-83dd-7c6c99f9fce4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Ali Kayali, the state-owned news agency SANA reported. Kayali is the primary suspect in the 2013 killing of hundreds of civilians in western Syria. At the time, he was the leader of a pro-government militant group.
* **Ukraine strikes Russian oil refinery:** Ukraine conducted a "large-scale attack" on an oil refinery in Ryazan, an industrial hub south of Moscow, Russia's defense ministry [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e2a0976c-13cb-4b71-8f0a-ab5bc47629e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday. The drone strike set the site on fire, the ministry added.
* This week, Ukraine said strikes on Russian refineries would continue, despite U.S. President Donald Trump's announcement of an "energy ceasefire" on Sunday. Russia has also reportedly attacked Ukrainian energy sites since the ceasefire was called.
* **Suspected Boko Haram fighters kill at least 10 soldiers in assault on Borno army base** : Suspected Boko Haram fighters attacked a Nigerian army base in Borno state on Tuesday, killing at least 10 soldiers and wounding at least 20 others, Reuters [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/c1e6bee2-62f5-4054-8d42-76596b5b0d98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). At least five civilians and a forest guard were also killed.
* **North Korea test-fires cruise missiles:** North Korea test-fired submarine-launched cruise missiles on Wednesday, the state-owned news agency KCNA [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/48d18beb-6e46-4ec2-b33f-43a49bda8742?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Among the test-fired missiles was a Pulhwasal-3-31, which North Korea reportedly fired from land last week. Its military is not believed to possess a fully operable missile submarine.
* **U.S. lifts sanctions on leading Venezuelan lawmaker** : Jorge Rodriguez, the president of the Venezuela federal legislature, was released from U.S. sanctions on Wednesday, Al Jazeera [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/96daae07-4618-44b4-9284-68978db618b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Rodriguez, who is the brother of interim President Delcy Rodriguez, was sanctioned under the first Trump administration. The U.S. lifted the sanctions as it seeks closer relations with the Venezuelan government.
* Earlier this year, the U.S. dropped its sanctions on Delcy Rodriguez, and later on Venezuela's central bank and state airline. Jorge Rodriguez has pushed legislation that opens the energy sectors to foreign investment.
* Nicolas Maduro and his wife, abducted by U.S. forces in January, [return](https://substack.com/redirect/c68c39e5-4075-4d4a-9ae2-b39a177177fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to court in Manhattan on Thursday to face a rewritten indictment accusing them of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of people. Maduro has denied the charges and is expected to plead not guilty.
* **Guyana opposition leader arrested after gunfire outside home of officer testifying in his extradition case** : Opposition leader Azruddin Mohamed and two other men were [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/18d24b6c-98eb-48b7-bda8-cb44f35f8cbe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) overnight Tuesday following gunfire outside the home of Senior Superintendent of Police Prem Narine, who is testifying in the U.S. extradition case against Mohamed, Reuters reported. The government said that Mohamed and his companions had been filming Narine's home, and that gunshots came from their vehicle. Mohamed's office says he did not possess a weapon, and that police planted it on him.
* In 2025, U.S. prosecutors indicted Azruddin Mohamed and his father Nazar on charges of conspiracy to commit fraud and money laundering, claiming that the two enriched themselves through gold exports and defrauded the Guyana government. The son and the father deny wrongdoing, and are contesting their extradition in court.
* **Former British Army chef jailed for possession of weapons for "terrorist purposes": **Mark Broadhurst, a former UK Army chef, was [sentenced](https://substack.com/redirect/ff90794d-893b-4e82-a2d2-70c171f7655c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to almost four years in prison on Wednesday, Al Jazeera reported. He was arrested in 2024, after police found a cache of weapons in his home, including what authorities called "an improvised homemade cannon." Police also discovered online messages in which he expressed racist views and an intention to sell homemade firearms to right-wing groups. He was a member of an online chat group with [three neo-Nazis](https://substack.com/redirect/6d04e268-f156-49b4-bf73-1a039567e7c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who were sentenced last year for planning a "terrorist" attack on mosques or synagogues in anticipation of a "race war."
* **India orders U.S. citizen, Bollywood actor Imran Khan to leave the country over protest:** Indian authorities [told ](https://substack.com/redirect/a3d7e327-dae7-449f-8e6b-004bf015d1b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)actor Imran Khan to leave India by the end of the month, saying he violated immigration laws by joining a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Khan is a U.S. citizen; under Indian law, foreigners can be punished for participating in protests.
* **School roof collapse in Peshawar kills over 30 children** : At least 32 schoolchildren and one teacher were [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/4668bd92-42aa-4cdf-8fe8-3b63e1be4d70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Thursday when a roof collapsed at Al-Khair Education Center, a school in Peshawar, Reuters reported. At least 45 children were injured, and three remain in critical condition. Rescuers spent hours pulling children from the rubble.
