Thursday, October 15, 2026 -** Yemen : Saudi-led coalition claims missile intercepted over holy city; Ansarallah denies launching attack. Ansarallah claims direct hit on Saudi fighter jet. EU-Gulf summit postponed. UN urges Ansarallah to release 71 detained staff members in Yemen. Palestine : Israel suspends commercial goods from entering Gaza. Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian near school in Gaza City. Israel's closure of Rafah blocks medical evacuations from Gaza for second week. Settlers attack Palestinians, damage farmland, and establish new outpost across the occupied West Bank. Israel has detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023, with 350 still confined. Israeli guards shoot Palestinian prisoners with rubber bullets at close range. Iran : U.S. military develops plans to strike Iranian energy and nuclear sites with "mother of all bombs," CNN reports. CENTCOM says it destroyed Iranian-linked surveillance vessel in Gulf of Oman. Iran must fight and negotiate simultaneously to deter future U.S. attacks, parliament speaker says. Iran vows further crackdown on Starlink. Lebanon: Israeli strikes wound two, including four-year-old, in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire. Hezbollah claims ownership of explosives seized in eastern Lebanon. U.S. : The U.S. is sending hundreds of troops to Latin America to fight drug traffickers. WSJ: Ilhan Omar investigation aims to strip her citizenship and deport her. Watchdog group sues to bar Jared Kushner from acting as envoy without Senate confirmation or financial disclosures. Illinois teen arrested over alleged mass shooting plot possibly targeting a Hindu temple. ICE rejects GAO recommendation for automatic body cameras. FTC sends civil subpoenas to OpenAI, Anthropic over consumer harms. Teamsters leader demands GOP super PAC pull Maine Senate ad that misattributes quote about Troy Jackson. Social Security benefits to rise 3.6% in 2027, an average of $75 a month. International: Five sentenced by Syrian court over mass sectarian violence. Ukraine strikes Russian oil refinery. Suspected Boko Haram fighters kill at least 10 soldiers in assault on Borno army base. North Korea test-fires cruise missiles. U.S. lifts sanctions on leading Venezuelan lawmaker. Guyana opposition leader arrested after gunfire outside home of officer testifying in his extradition case. Former British Army chef jailed for possession of weapons for "terrorist purposes." India orders U.S. citizen, Bollywood actor Imran Khan to leave the country over protest. School roof collapse in Peshawar kills over 30 children. This is Drop Site Daily, our free news recap We send it Monday - Friday Yemen Saudi-led coalition claims missile intercepted over holy city; Ansarallah denies launching attack: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen Thursday that its forces intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile over the Medina region of Saudi Arabia, according to the coalition spokesperson. Ansarallah said Yemeni forces had not carried out any attacks against Saudi territory on Thursday. A spokesperson described Saudi Arabia's allegation of an attempted strike on the Islamic holy city as a "great and blatant fabrication." Ansarallah claims direct hit on Saudi fighter jet: A Saudi Typhoon fighter jet was with a surface-to-air missile over Saada governorate in northern Yemen, Ansarallah forces claimed. The aircraft had taken off from Taif Air Base in Saudi Arabia and sustained a direct hit, leaving it at risk of crashing. The claim has not been independently verified. EU-Gulf summit postponed: A summit of European Union and Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) leaders scheduled for next week in Riyadh was following Ansarallah attacks on Saudi Arabia and the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport. The decision was made to ensure the safety of participating delegations, the GCC Secretary-General announced Thursday. A new date will be announced later, the European Council said, reaffirming its commitment to strengthening ties with Gulf states. Gulf states hope the summit will advance efforts towards Schengen visa exemptions. Bulgaria is also pushing for a railway corridor that can transport Saudi oil to Europe through Syria, Turkey, and Bulgaria, bypassing the blockaded Strait of Hormuz. UN urges Ansarallah to release 71 detained staff members in Yemen: The United Nations on Ansarallah to release all detained personnel from the UN, NGOs, civil society organizations and diplomatic missions, following the release of UN staff member Sami Al-Kalabi, who had been held in Sana'a since 2024. A total of 71 UN staff members remain in Ansarallah detention, many without charge or trial. Ansarallah has accused some detained UN and humanitarian workers of espionage and collaboration with the U.S. and Israel. It has not provided evidence for those accusations. Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch have repeatedly called for Ansarallah to release "the dozens of arbitrarily detained members of Yemen's civil society and UN staff," and have documented Ansarallah's use of torture and abuse in its detention facilities. Palestine Israel suspends commercial goods from entering Gaza: Israel has the entry of private-sector goods into Gaza over allegations that Hamas threatened and coerced merchants, according to Nickolay Mladenov, High Representative President Donald Trump's "Board of Peace." The decision further restricts essential supplies for more than two million Palestinians in the devastated enclave. Gaza relies on the entry of a combination of humanitarian aid and commercial goods that have both been subjected to heavy Israeli restrictions. Mladenov said he received a letter from Israel's Coordinator of Government Activities in the Territories informing him of the suspension. He condemned the alleged intimidation of merchants as "unacceptable" but did not call on Israel to reverse the decision or specify when commercial deliveries might resume. Hunger in Gaza remains at crisis levels following a full-blown famine declared in the summer, according to the world's leading authority on food insecurity, the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification. Israeli drone strike kills Palestinian near school in Gaza City: A Palestinian was killed and several others were wounded by an Israeli drone near the Ibad Al-Rahman School, northwest of Gaza City, on Thursday, according to WAFA. Over the past 24 hours, four Palestinians were killed and nine injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health. The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023, is now 74,396 killed, with 175,449 injured. Since October 11, 2025, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,505 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 5,332, while 838 bodies have been recovered. Israel 's closure of Rafah blocks medical evacuations from Gaza for second week: Israel has kept the Rafah border crossing closed for a second consecutive week, preventing sick and wounded Palestinians from leaving Gaza for medical treatment abroad, Gaza's Health Ministry said Thursday. Medical-leave waitlists for ailing Palestinians are growing daily, as peoples' needs far exceed the capacity of Gaza's devastated and besieged hospitals to accommodate patients or provide even minimum levels of treatment, the ministry said. Settlers attack Palestinians, damage farmland, and establish new outpost across the occupied West Bank: Ramallah: Israeli settlers Palestinian olive pickers in Burqa village, east of Ramallah, on Thursday, WAFA reported. Israeli forces blocked the village entrance, obstructing an ambulance for several hours. Hebron: Settlers vehicles carrying Palestinian Medical Relief Society teams and attempted to prevent them from reaching Khirbet Al-Majaz, in Masafer Yatta, to provide medical care. In Beit Ummar, north of Hebron, settlers destroyed crops and cut irrigation pipes belonging to a Palestinian farmer. Salfit: Settlers a new pastoral settlement outpost in Wadi Yasuf, east of Salfit, erecting tents on Palestinian land. Nablus: Settlers electricity poles connected to a home in Burin, south of Nablus. The home, located near the Yitzhar settlement, has been repeatedly targeted by settlers. Israel has detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023, with 350 still confined: Israeli forces have detained more than 2,000 Palestinian children since October 2023, with 350 currently held in "harsh conditions," according to a report from the Palestinian Prisoner's Society. Palestinian children face abuses ranging from "intimidation and arrest" to "torture, starvation and denial of healthcare," the group said. Israeli guards shoot Palestinian prisoners with rubber bullets at close range: Israeli prison guards have shot rubber bullets at Palestinian inmates at close range, two Israeli rights groups warned, to AP. The two groups documented nearly two dozen, most of which have occurred since last fall, compared to only a handful of incidents documented over the prior decade. According to the groups Physicians for Human Rights Israel and the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel, prisoners have been struck by rubber bullets in the legs, knees, stomach and pelvic area, according to the reports, with many not being treated for their injuries. The Israel Prison Service's legal adviser, in response to a letter from rights groups, said it saw no reason to stop using rubber bullets in "measured" and "appropriate" ways. Iran U.S. military develops plans to strike Iranian energy and nuclear sites with "mother of all bombs," CNN reports: The U.S. military new strike plans that include deploying the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), the largest non-nuclear bomb in its arsenal, against Iranian energy infrastructure and nuclear facilities, should President Donald Trump order renewed attacks before or after the November midterm elections, according to CNN. Officials questioned whether the MOAB could destroy deeply buried nuclear facilities. The bomb is designed primarily for massive surface-level destruction rather than deep penetration. Some military planners described potential strikes as a "fireworks show" intended to give Trump a symbolic victory and a way out of the war. Others suggested the MOAB could serve as a psychological weapon to pressure Tehran to make a deal. At a rally in Arizona, Trump claimed that the war on Iran would end "very soon" and predicted fuel prices would fall once the fighting stopped. "I knew gasoline would go high, but I had no idea," he said. "I thought it was going to go much higher, to be honest with you." CENTCOM says it destroyed Iranian-linked surveillance vessel in Gulf of Oman: U.S. forces an Iranian-affiliated dhow in the Gulf of Oman on October 6, claiming the vessel was conducting surveillance and targeting U.S. Navy warships, according to U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM). At least 10 ships have been attacked in or near the Strait of Hormuz since Sunday, the highest number over such a period since the U.S.-Israeli war against Iran began. Six vessels were attacked Sunday and four Tuesday, while two sailors are reportedly missing and a cargo ship was reportedly sunk by an Iranian naval mine. Iran must fight and negotiate simultaneously to deter future U.S. attacks, parliament speaker says: Iran must combine military action with diplomacy to establish lasting deterrence, as neither negotiations nor military confrontation alone can guarantee the country's security, Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf Wednesday. Ghalibaf argued that Washington's pursuit of regional dominance meant military pressure alone would not force it to abandon its objectives. "Whenever we achieve a military victory on the battlefield, we must also turn that victory into a political victory, consolidate it and turn it into a document of defeat for the enemy," he said. Iran vows further crackdown on Starlink: Iranian authorities pledged to intensify efforts to disrupt Elon Musk's Starlink satellite internet service, describing it as a "tool of war." "It is a tool used for command and control by the enemy, for espionage and information gathering," the secretary of Iran's Supreme National Cyberspace Council said. Iran has imposed two prolonged internet shutdowns this year, including an 88-day blackout following the start of the U.S.-Israeli war in February. Lebanon Israeli strikes wound two, including four-year-old, in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire: Israeli forces the town of Kfar Tebnit in the Nabatieh district on Thursday, while artillery shelling targeted Mansouri and Majdal Zoun in the Tyre (Sour) district, according to Lebanon's National News Agency. Israeli troops Lebanese farmers from Kfar Shouba to leave the Azrael and Bastara areas while they were harvesting olives. Two people, including a four-year-old, were in an Israeli airstrike on Hadatha, Bint Jbeil on Wednesday. Hezbollah claims ownership of explosives seized in eastern Lebanon: Hezbollah MP Hassan Fadlallah Thursday that a vehicle intercepted by Lebanese authorities at the Dahr Al-Baydar checkpoint in eastern Lebanon belonged to the group and was carrying materials used to fight Israeli forces. He demanded the release of those detained and the return of the vehicle and its contents, saying the explosives, including C-4, were intended exclusively for use against Israel. Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam pledged Monday to hold accountable those responsible for transporting the explosives toward Beirut, expressing concern that C-4 had been used in political assassinations in Lebanon's recent history. Fadlallah rejected the suggestion of a connection to assassinations, accusing the government of fueling internal divisions and serving Israeli and American interests. U.S. News The U.S. is sending hundreds of troops to Latin America to fight drug traffickers: The Pentagon is a 600-soldier battalion from the 10th Mountain Division to train and exercise with local forces in Latin America, U.S. military officials told the New York Times on Wednesday. The first elements are deploying to a new jungle training facility in Panama. They will later train with forces in Colombia, taking part in the Southern Vanguard exercise later this month, and Honduras. They could also provide security for U.S. helicopters in raids against alleged traffickers. Gen. Francis Donovan , head of Southern Command, has said the U.S. plans to expand from boat strikes to land strikes against "narco-terrorists," and only a handful of countries, including Colombia and Honduras, have agreed to joint operations on their soil. WSJ: Ilhan Omar investigation aims to strip her citizenship and deport her : The Trump administration's probe of Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-Minn.) is aimed at building a case to revoke her U.S. citizenship and ultimately deport her, the Wall Street Journal . Agents searched her Washington home early Monday, taking her cellphone, notebooks, personal computers, and passport. At the center of the investigation is whether Omar or her father altered her age on her citizenship application to show 17 rather than 18, which would have qualified her automatically through his naturalization in 2000. More than a dozen subpoenas seek testimony before a Minnesota grand jury about the family's immigration paperwork. Homeland Security Investigations examined a similar tip under Biden and declined to proceed for lack of evidence of fraud. Watchdog group sues to bar Jared Kushner from acting as envoy without Senate confirmation or financial disclosures : Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics suit against special envoy Jared Kushner and the White House, arguing he "holds a continuing position and wields significant government authority" while running Affinity Partners, a Miami investment firm with over $6 billion under management, about 99% of it owned by foreign investors, mostly from the Gulf states. CREW asks the court to block the Trump administration from continuing his role until the Senate confirms him and he files all financial disclosures. Illinois teen arrested over alleged mass shooting plot possibly targeting a Hindu temple : Police from the town of Palatine, Illinois, 19-year-old Alexandros Paporakis on Sunday. Detectives who searched his home recovered a rifle, multiple loaded magazines, hundreds of rounds of ammunition, and a tactical vest with body armor and a patch bearing white supremacist imagery. They also found a document titled "Why I fought: A.K.A.: (Aurora Shooter's Manifesto)" expressing white supremacist views and referencing violence toward South Asians, specifically Indians. Authorities are investigating whether he planned to attack a Hindu temple in Aurora, about 40 miles southwest of Palatine. ICE rejects GAO recommendation for automatic body cameras : A Government Accountability Office recommended ICE use "automated camera activation" for unplanned use-of-force incidents, such as when an officer draws a weapon or turns on a siren. DHS rejected it, saying automatic activation could cause "the unauthorized recording of sensitive interactions with informants or victims." DHS told GAO all ICE offices had received cameras by Aug. 5, but on Wednesday said required training was still ongoing and should finish "soon." GAO also found officers at ICE and CBP were confused about when to activate cameras, such as during vehicle searches or detainee transport, and that one ICE office hadn't begun using them even after training. FTC sends civil subpoenas to OpenAI, Anthropic over consumer harms : The Federal Trade Commission is documents on security incidents and safeguarding practices, plus marketing materials and privacy policies, from Anthropic and Open AI, in a probe focused on potential consumer protection violations, Axios reports. Demands to third-party AI organizations will follow later, Axios reported, and the FTC plans to compel top AI executives to testify. Teamsters leader demands GOP super PAC pull Maine Senate ad that misattributes quote about Troy Jackson : Lawyers for Gregory Floyd , president of New York's Teamsters Local 237, the Senate Leadership Fund a cease-and-desist letter, first obtained by NBC News, over an ad attacking Maine Democratic Senate candidate Troy Jackson 's "Medicare for All" support. The ad's caption reads "Troy Jackson's 'plan is a disaster,'" attributed to Floyd. Floyd says he never commented on Jackson's plan--his comment was about a 2019 version by presidential candidate Elizabeth Warren --and that the ad conveys a "false and defamatory" message. Social Security benefits to rise 3.6% in 2027, an average of $75 a month : The Social Security Administration announced a 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027, raising retirement benefits by an average of $75 a month. Nearly 72 million Social Security beneficiaries will see higher payments starting in January, and about 7.3 million SSI recipients will see increases starting December 31, 2026. It follows September inflation of 3.7%, up from 3.4% in August and the highest since a three-year peak of 4.2% in May. 📥 Have a tip on Capitol Hill? Email DC Correspondent Julian Andreone at Julian@dropsitenews.com Other International News Five sentenced by Syrian court over mass sectarian violence: Two people were sentenced to death and three others to prison terms by a Syrian court on Thursday over their roles in a campaign of sectarian violence last year in the Alawite region of coastal Syria. In March 2025, an uprising by elements of the former Assad regime was followed by a much larger and violent backlash by militias and security forces affiliated with the current Syrian government that spiraled into widespread sectarian violence that killed over 1,500 people. Read Drop Site's coverage of the massacre . Separately, Syrian intelligence officials Ali Kayali, the state-owned news agency SANA reported. Kayali is the primary suspect in the 2013 killing of hundreds of civilians in western Syria. At the time, he was the leader of a pro-government militant group. Ukraine strikes Russian oil refinery: Ukraine conducted a "large-scale attack" on an oil refinery in Ryazan, an industrial hub south of Moscow, Russia's defense ministry Thursday. The drone strike set the site on fire, the ministry added. This week, Ukraine said strikes on Russian refineries would continue, despite U.S. President Donald Trump's announcement of an "energy ceasefire" on Sunday. Russia has also reportedly attacked Ukrainian energy sites since the ceasefire was called. Suspected Boko Haram fighters kill at least 10 soldiers in assault on Borno army base : Suspected Boko Haram fighters attacked a Nigerian army base in Borno state on Tuesday, killing at least 10 soldiers and wounding at least 20 others, Reuters . At least five civilians and a forest guard were also killed. North Korea test-fires cruise missiles: North Korea test-fired submarine-launched cruise missiles on Wednesday, the state-owned news agency KCNA . Among the test-fired missiles was a Pulhwasal-3-31, which North Korea reportedly fired from land last week. Its military is not believed to possess a fully operable missile submarine. U.S. lifts sanctions on leading Venezuelan lawmaker : Jorge Rodriguez, the president of the Venezuela federal legislature, was released from U.S. sanctions on Wednesday, Al Jazeera . Rodriguez, who is the brother of interim President Delcy Rodriguez, was sanctioned under the first Trump administration. The U.S. lifted the sanctions as it seeks closer relations with the Venezuelan government. Earlier this year, the U.S. dropped its sanctions on Delcy Rodriguez, and later on Venezuela's central bank and state airline. Jorge Rodriguez has pushed legislation that opens the energy sectors to foreign investment. Nicolas Maduro and his wife, abducted by U.S. forces in January, to court in Manhattan on Thursday to face a rewritten indictment accusing them of leading a state-sponsored campaign of repression that tortured scores of people. Maduro has denied the charges and is expected to plead not guilty. Guyana opposition leader arrested after gunfire outside home of officer testifying in his extradition case : Opposition leader Azruddin Mohamed and two other men were overnight Tuesday following gunfire outside the home of Senior Superintendent of Police Prem Narine, who is testifying in the U.S. extradition case against Mohamed, Reuters reported. The government said that Mohamed and his companions had been filming Narine's home, and that gunshots came from their vehicle. Mohamed's office says he did not possess a weapon, and that police planted it on him. In 2025, U.S. prosecutors indicted Azruddin Mohamed and his father Nazar on charges of conspiracy to commit fraud and money laundering, claiming that the two enriched themselves through gold exports and defrauded the Guyana government. The son and the father deny wrongdoing, and are contesting their extradition in court. Former British Army chef jailed for possession of weapons for "terrorist purposes": Mark Broadhurst, a former UK Army chef, was to almost four years in prison on Wednesday, Al Jazeera reported. He was arrested in 2024, after police found a cache of weapons in his home, including what authorities called "an improvised homemade cannon." Police also discovered online messages in which he expressed racist views and an intention to sell homemade firearms to right-wing groups. He was a member of an online chat group with who were sentenced last year for planning a "terrorist" attack on mosques or synagogues in anticipation of a "race war." India orders U.S. citizen, Bollywood actor Imran Khan to leave the country over protest: Indian authorities Imran Khan to leave India by the end of the month, saying he violated immigration laws by joining a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Khan is a U.S. citizen; under Indian law, foreigners can be punished for participating in protests. I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor.

| Peter,
**I know your inbox is probably overflowing right now with politicians begging for your hard-earned money using every scare tactic in the book.**

My last message didn't get the response I was hoping for, and now I'm starting to feel like we're falling behind. We can't keep fighting if we don't have the resources to keep the lights on and pay my amazing staff.
Let me take a second to re-introduce myself: _**My name is Jen Kiggans.**_
I am a former Navy helicopter pilot. I flew H-46s and H-3s in the Persian Gulf. After my time in the military, I used my GI Bill benefits to go back to school and become a board-certified Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. I am married to a retired Navy F/A-18 pilot, and now I am a proud Navy Mom.

And that is exactly __**WHY**__ I ran for Congress in 2022.
I knew that I needed to step up and do my part to make sure that my four kids inherit a GREAT America!
Against all odds, we flipped Virginia's 2nd District **RED** in one of the tightest, must-win races in the entire country. But elections have serious consequences and these radical Left Democrats are not going to give up without a fight.
Now, National Democrats and Left-leaning Super PACs are raking in millions to attack me and take back the House this year. They want to turn our great commonwealth into California AND my far-Left opponent announced she raised over $1.6 MILLION in the last quarter alone.
_They will stop at absolutely nothing to win._
So today, I’m recruiting YOU to join my mission to save our country from the Democrats' grasp once and for all. That is why I am about to ask you what I know is no small favor. **[Will you chip in just a few dollars to support a former Navy pilot on this critical mission to SAVE OUR GOP HOUSE MAJORITY?](https://trk.join.jenforcongress.-g)**

As a Navy Vet, I've never turned away from a tough fight, and trust me, I won't start now. But to keep our House Majority intact and continue fighting for our country’s future, I really need your support!
Thank you all so very, very much!
\- Jen Kiggans

I would not be where I am today without the help of my incredible and faithful supporters like you. Because of your support, I can keep fighting to make our country stronger.

Together we will get our country back on the right track and secure America’s success!

I want to start with an apology.
Not for asking for your support -- but for the possibility that we may not have done enough to earn it.

[It's Congressman Brandon Gill. name: Finance Team @ Shapiro HQ
subject: The unglamorous truth about campaigns
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, this is the
Finance Team at Shapiro HQ, and this is going to be the most boring email
in your inbox today. 😬

No story. No metaphor. Just a clear picture of where $200,000 goes if we
hit our last mid-month fundraising goal tonight:

Additional digital ads in our swingiest of swing counties.

More literature for organizers in both English and Spanish.

A mail drop that has to be at the printer by Monday.

(And maybe a cup or two of coffee for our volunteers!)

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17452?t=1001&akid=637%2E245147%2El6KgKK ]That's the whole budget, and every dollar we fall short of comes off
one of those four lines. So we're asking right now: Will you chip in
$25 to help
us keep all four budgets fully funded through Election Day?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17452?t=1002&akid=637%2E245147%2El6KgKK ]Chip in →

We’re sharing this because people often ask where their money goes, so we
want to be honest about what's underneath it all.

There's nothing dramatic about a mail printing deadline,
Derek. But a mailer that misses
the press on Monday doesn't land before ballots are due, and a voter who
doesn't hear from us is a voter who only hears from our opponent and
Donald Trump's allies.

That's the unglamorous version of how elections actually get decided in
the most competitive battleground state in the nation.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17452?t=1003&akid=637%2E245147%2El6KgKK ]So please,
Derek: Rush $25 or whatever you can
before midnight — because this is our last mid-month deadline of the
campaign before Election Day, and the four lines above don't get a second
shot.

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17453?t=1004&akid=637%2E245147%2El6KgKK ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17452?t=1009&akid=637%2E245147%2El6KgKK ]Other →

Thank you,

Josh Shapiro Finance Team

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.

subject: Watch My New Ad: “Mission”

body:
364 votes. None missed. Over 250 district events. Watch my new ad, “Mission,” and make your plan to vote early.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/mJRfV42KUea?e=f4ab36d7f7&c2id=a07f240cd81bc7fca97bfaaae558cfa1)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter,
All my adult life, I’ve worn the uniform, from the Plain at West Point to flying combat missions overseas. I learned that when you’re given a mission, you show up and get the job done.
I’ve brought that same mindset to Congress. **364 votes. Not a single one missed.**
I’m the **only member of Tennessee’s congressional delegation with a perfect voting attendance record,** and I’ve **attended more than 250 events** across our district since being elected.
My new ad, **“Mission,”** tells that story and highlights my work standing up for veterans, voting to ban congressional stock trading, and fighting for Tennessee values.

Service has never been about a title. It’s about the mission. And my mission is fighting for you.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/MaV2XCdXJ7U?e=f4ab36d7f7&c2id=a07f240cd81bc7fca97bfaaae558cfa1)
| | **Early voting is underway through October 29, and Election Day is November 3.**
I’d be honored to earn your vote so we can keep fighting Washington corruption, protecting taxpayer dollars, lowering costs, and taking care of our veterans.Make your plan to vote, bring a friend, and help us finish strong.
Thank you for the honor of serving Tennessee.
Matt

body:
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141479002/653692508/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2E1MzRkNS1hZmM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m4FIaHrdldM9Oz6uhqaA61b5WwFop-96cSwIBFmOPnw=)
Enough.
Once again, ICE agents have taken lives on the streets of our communities. And once again, we're being told to move on.
**I won't.**
For too long, ICE has operated with little or no accountability, too much secrecy, and devastating consequences for families across this country.
Every time another tragedy occurs, we're promised investigations and reforms — and that this time will be different.
But people keep getting hurt. People keep dying. And the cycle continues.
**I believe we've reached the point where we have to stop pretending this agency can be fixed with minor changes around the edges. ICE has become an institution that too often operates without meaningful accountability, and the American people deserve better.**
**[That's why I'm asking you to stand with me today. Add your name if you agree: It's time to abolish ICE and hold everyone responsible for these deaths fully accountable.>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141479003/653692509/116784635?refcode=261015_RG_abolish-ice-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhN2E1MzRkNS1hZmM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m4FIaHrdldM9Oz6uhqaA61b5WwFop-96cSwIBFmOPnw=&emci=ee804cb1-afc8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=a7a534d5-afc8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=16877361)**

No one should lose their life because of an agency that has repeatedly demonstrated a disregard for transparency and human rights.
No officer who abuses their authority should be shielded from consequences.

The evidence board

| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — the pause.** Trump has said the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports stays in place, but that the U.S. won’t attack Iran before the November 3 midterm elections.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — the response.** Shipping monitors recorded 15 attacks between October 6 and 14, 11 of them in four days. According to Kpler, crude passing through Hormuz fell from nearly 20.8 million barrels on October 8 to about 2.9 million on October 11.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the price.** Brent crude closed at $105.69 on Tuesday and traded above $106 on Wednesday. Before the war, it was around $72.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the squeeze.** Kpler’s head of crude analysis says Iran’s oil export revenue could dry up entirely by mid-December, for the first time in its history.
| OUR THEORY

Iran appears to want gasoline prices high just as Americans head to the polls. The nuclear program explains why the war started. Oil explains how it’s being fought.

This Saturday or Sunday, you can funnel your determination to fight for our democracy into sustained action by talking with voters in the competitive swing districts and states that will help determine the national balance of power for years to come. body:
|
#
Friend, With _19 days_ left to go, here’s a quick reminder of what Kristen is up against – and what’s at stake in this race. Kristen’s opponent, Tom Smith, is best known for pushing far-right conspiracy theories, amplifying messages that called for the execution of President Trump’s political opponents (he later deleted all 13,000 of them), and being a proud January 6th attendee. Hey — I just wanted to say thank you, truly, for all of the incredible support you’ve given this campaign. Your generosity has helped us crush every single one of our fundraising goals, including last night’s final FEC deadline. Your donations do SO much to pave our path to victory: on-the-ground organizing, mailers countering MAGA attack ads, TV commercials about our plan for getting costs down, and the very expensive fuel in the tank of the run-down RAV-4 that is taking me to every corner of Central and Southside Virginia between now and Election Day. **There are still thousands of undecided voters, and thousands of people who haven’t decided if they’ll vote at all. Those people are the majority makers in this race, and our race may be the majority maker for restoring our system of checks and balances.** In the campaign that sent me to Congress with President Obama, we won by 727 votes – _about two votes per precinct_. That victory allowed me to be the deciding vote to pass the Affordable Care Act. We are leaving nothing to chance. We are working to reach every voter in this district – those who have not yet decided to vote and those who have not yet decided who they will vote for. When folks around here get basic facts about what Rep. John McGuire has done and what he has failed to do, and when they hear about what we represent as an alternative, our path to victory gets clearer and clearer. Earlier this week, I got to campaign with the great John Grisham in Lynchburg. As I spoke with many of the 300+ fans who packed into Givens Books, people shared why his books meant so much to them. We are hungry for a world in which even the most powerful corporations and corrupt leaders can be held accountable to justice. We cheer for the determined, gritty team that has the guts to face down long odds. We cherish living in a country and in a world in which the rule of law wins out over might makes right. And we are hungry for those principles to exist beyond the fiction section! The same hope that inspires people to buy his latest – The French Illusion [not a paid product placement!] – is also inspiring people to vote early, persuade neighbors, make a donation, like a social media post, and have the audacity to hope that a coalition of conscience will win out over the current corruption, chaos, and cruelty. Thank you again. From the bottom of my heart – you are the reason this campaign is possible, and you are the reason we are giving hope to so many people across VA-05 who’d given up on politics. We need to keep going. With gratitude,Tom Perriello P.S. If you didn’t get a chance to contribute before our FEC deadline, it’s not too late to make an impact on the outcome of this race. We’re going to be fundraising up until the very last second, because it’s not over until it’s over – there are doors to be knocked, calls to be made, voters to be talked to, every moment until polls close on November 3. Your generosity has helped us crush every single one of our fundraising goals, including last night’s final FEC deadline. name: Elisabeth Wales
subject: VOLUNTEER WITH TEAM HELENA! Join us!!
body:
Hi everyone,

The general election is almost here and we need all of your support to make
it across the finish line! We’d love to see you at our upcoming volunteer
events.

Cheer on Helena before the final debate!

Join fellow volunteers outside Roberts Hall Auditorium at Rhode Island
College on Tuesday, October 20, at 6:00 p.m.

Phone banking every day until election day! - two shifts available!

Join us at 188 Valley St., Providence, RI, for either or both daily shifts:

-

Morning shift: 10:00AM – 12:30PM
-

Evening shift: 5:00PM – 7:30PM

Sign up to volunteer here
<https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdm323tHI5RiPPYaW2bRskye4oLb4J7zIATZYSURz3wowpQIg/viewform>
!

Thank you for your time, energy, and continued support. We’re excited to
see you!

With gratitude,
Elisabeth

name: Dave Beckwith for Congress
subject: Dave Beckwith for Congress Upcoming Events!
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Dave Beckwith For Congress_
body:
| | | | Hi Friend,
**We have lots of events coming up this next week, and I want you to join us!**
From debates, to forums, to meet and greets, to volunteer opportunities, there is a lot going on through the end of the election. Here's everything we've got on the schedule:****__****__
---
**TONIGHT October 15th: Candidate Forum (this is an important one!)** Come show your support as Dave faces Suhas and answers questions about the issues we're facing in VA-10. **Entry is FREE** and open to everyone (no need to RSVP), but seats are limited. Be sure to arrive before the doors open at 6pm!
_When: 6-8 pm_ _Where: Manassas Community Center, 8750 Sudley Road Manassas, VA 20110_

**October 16th: Veteran Candidate Meet & Greet hosted by American Veteran Vote.** At this meet & greet, you'll have the chance to hear from Dave, as well as veteran candidates from across Northern Virginia! Also in attendance will be Doug Ollivant of VA-7, Arthur Purves of VA-11, and Tony Sabio from VA-8. If you have friends or family in those districts, send this event to them too! **Please RSVP to******[mkershner@americanveteransvote.com](mailto:mkershner@americanveteransvote.com)****
_When: 6-8 pm_ _Where: GPR Headquarters, 22365 Broderick Drive Sterling, VA 20166_

**October 24th: Get Out The Vote Party!** Join us at the 10th District GOP Headquarters for a fun Saturday afternoon to help get out the vote! There will be free food, music, and guest speakers - including Vince Coglianese from WMAL!
_When: 11am - 1pm_ _Where: Leesburg Office of Elections, 750 Miller Drive Suite 150 Leesburg, VA 20175_

**October 25th: Final Door Knocking Day** Last, but certainly not least, we will be having our final door knocking day for Dave. We will meet in the morning at the GOP Headquarters for breakfast and coffee, then all head out and knock those doors! Please RSVP to [vote@beckwithforcongress.com](mailto:vote@beckwithforcongress.com) or text the volunteer coordinator at 571-436-7517. All are welcome to join!
_When: starting at 10am, park in the back of the building_ _Where: 20098 Ashbrook Commons Place, suite #150 Ashburn, VA 2014_
|
---
There's a lot going on as the election approaches. I can't thank you all enough for your support throughout this campaign, it has meant the world to me.
Now is the final push and my final ask for your support at these upcoming community and volunteer events.**Let's win this!**
| | | God Bless, Dave Beckwith
**Beckwith for Congress** _Restoring Faith in the American Dream_

---
|
---
**We're in the home stretch!** This campaign has come so far, and I'm so honor to have had your support all along the way. Will you chip in $10, $20, or $50 more to help me in this final push?
[DONATE TO PROPEL DAVE TO VICTORY!]()
|
---
**Thank you for supporting Dave's Campaign!** Follow along with the campaign on socials! Like, comment, repost, an share with a friend who you think should hear Dave's message.
| [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.) | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.) | [](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---|---|---
| | |
---

You can rejoin us at anytime! We'll be glad to have you back.

Today is the first day you can vote early in-person here in North Carolina! Even if you aren't yet registered to vote, you can register and vote at the same time during early voting. For the next two weeks and change, folks all across the state will be casting their ballots for their next U.S. Senator.
I voted early this morning!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a8e265e-434f-49ea-94cb-6f7af8891fc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I know it can be easy to get lost in the endless stream of countdowns and deadlines, but they are real checkpoints for our campaign. And today, we are entering the final stretch of this race.
As polls open, our opponent is picking up some steam, but we always knew this race would tighten. Elections in North Carolina are won or lost along the margins, and the only way we win is by building momentum day after day. **There have been too many good Democratic nominees for Senate in North Carolina with October polling leads who lose in November, and we can 't let that happen.**
So starting today, when you, your friends and family head out to vote, wherever you are, we need to be ready. We need to finish this election strong and head into November with the momentum and resources to take on everything the far-right will throw at us.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/cd244f12-505c-4f96-9182-64d00f0204e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I've won tough statewide races here before, and I know how to do it again: with grassroots supporters like you powering us to victory.
Thank you for being a part of this fight. Whether you've spent part of your weekend knocking doors, chipping in when you could or just staying updated on this race, every conversation and every last effort matters.
**Just because polls are open doesn 't mean our work is over; in fact, in many ways it's just beginning.** We must make sure the people we have had positive interactions with actually go to the polls and vote. We need to keep growing this grassroots movement and make sure that we have the resources necessary to contact every eligible voter across the state and help them execute on a plan to vote.
We have a lot of work ahead of us before November 3rd, but with your help, we can finish strong.
[Will you chip in $5, or whatever you can spare, to keep our momentum going through early voting and all the way until Election Day?](https://substack.com/redirect/cd244f12-505c-4f96-9182-64d00f0204e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you.
P.S. If you're in North Carolina, you can find your early voting polling location and hours [here](https://substack.com/redirect/b9005231-59ca-46d6-9123-89970517f52c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And with valid forms of identification, you can register to vote at your polling place during early voting. Learn how to register [here](https://substack.com/redirect/22758bb0-f7b7-410f-a771-fbc80f5a9c00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

#### **[Sanford Extends Mill Emergency as Building Crumbles, Police Make Arrests and $35 Million Demolition Question Looms](https://substack.com/redirect/e33b3a54-5aad-4cd9-af61-e4a132db91cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Sanford's city council voted Tuesday night to keep its emergency declaration and the Heritage Crossing closure in place with no reopening date. City Manager Steve Buck told councilors that tearing the International Woolen Mill down could cost more than $35 million once you count the environmental cleanup. A beam he saw cracked on Sept. 30 has since collapsed. The city has spent about $25,000 boarding up entrances, and the metal barriers were reportedly cut open with power tools. Police aren't allowed inside at night, except in emergencies, because the building could come down on them. The mill is still privately owned, and no funded plan to fix it has been announced. Buck also said it's wrong to credit the media for the city finally acting: "We've been months in the planning." Months of planning, and so far the plan is barriers and patrols.

#### **[Hannaford Hit by Another Cybersecurity Incident, Disrupting Online Grocery Services Across Maine](https://substack.com/redirect/19afc02f-985f-47a4-ad35-761cac439d7b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Ahold Delhaize, the Netherlands-based company that owns Hannaford, said Monday it found a "security issue" in its network and pulled systems offline. That took down Hannaford's website, app and Hannaford To Go. Stores and pharmacies are open, and orders that can't be filled will be refunded. The company says it has no evidence customer or employee data was taken this time. Last time was the November 2024 breach, which hit 2,242,521 people nationwide, 95,463 of them in Maine. Neither of this week's company statements spells out what changed after that one.
#### **[Minor Charged after Hoax Bomb Threat Against Waterville High School Leads to Evacuation](https://substack.com/redirect/bd0fefcb-d2ef-4aa4-b5d3-8d3b361f7417?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Waterville police got the call around 7 a.m. Wednesday, emptied Waterville Senior High, searched it and found nothing. Kids were sent home for the day anyway, and a minor has been charged. Rep. Flavia DeBrito (D-Waterville) put out a long statement asking whether we're "talking enough about what these experiences do to our children's nervous systems." Shawn Packard, the Republican running against her, said much the same about the kids, then added that "someone's actions caused that fear in the first place."
#### **[Portland Police to Train with Swedish Investigators as Maine Confronts Sex Trafficking and Commercial Sexual Exploitation](https://substack.com/redirect/823f1a61-d416-40cc-96b7-faafc1a75cfd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
In 2023, Maine stopped charging people for selling sex and kept the penalties for buying it. It was the first state to do that statewide, borrowing an approach Sweden pioneered in 1999. Now Swedish prosecutors and police are coming to Portland Oct. 19-23 for a two-hour training, organized by a nonprofit called Wake Up Brother. Portland didn't say how many officers will attend, and it didn't release any trafficking arrest or prosecution numbers since the law changed. A group of Maine officials is also supposed to go to Sweden next spring. The department hasn't said who's going or who's paying.
#### **[Kittery Point Man Arrested After Fleeing Crash that Injured Motorcyclist](https://substack.com/redirect/efeb41da-42df-4962-ac5c-00a312676d9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Oxford County deputies say a Mazda allegedly passed a stopped pickup on the right in Newry on Saturday and hit Donald Dyer Jr., 67, of Standish, as he turned onto Mayville Road on his motorcycle. Dyer was thrown from the bike and taken to Rumford Hospital with significant injuries. The driver kept going. Deputies found the car, passenger side smashed in, at the Irving in Bethel. Henry Clark, 23, of Kittery Point, faces five charges, including OUI causing serious bodily injury, aggravated leaving the scene and aggravated assault with a dangerous weapon.
#### **[Homeless Man Arrested After Breaking Into Shapleigh Storage Units](https://substack.com/redirect/d2c54f85-8305-42c3-93bd-73c4f0ffbb91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
York County deputies answered a suspicious-person call at a Shapleigh storage lot at 6:30 Tuesday morning and found Jason Desruisseaux, 38, behind one of the units. Several units had been broken into. His bail conditions allowed a search on the spot, and deputies say they turned up a grinder and bolt cutters, plus a motorcycle allegedly stolen from one of the units. He's charged with burglary and violating conditions of release. He's held without bail, which these days counts as news.
## Videos from @TheMaineWire on X
**[Sanford's crowd doesn't like cameras](https://substack.com/redirect/a535cd2c-441a-4496-86f6-c0af3de878ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**: Jon went back to Sanford, and the crowd at what looked like a drug-dealing convention was not happy to see him. This was our most-watched video of the day.
**[Is the mill safe? ## Politics to Watch this Week...
**Collins vs. Jackson, final debate** : **tonight, 7 p.m.** , Gracie Theater in Bangor. It's the only one with a live audience and voter questions, co-hosted by Maine Public, NEWS CENTER Maine and the Press Herald. Collins picked up the Maine Fraternal Order of Police endorsement Wednesday ([WABI](https://substack.com/redirect/264c8b63-502e-4859-a41f-e82595f2ccf4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). ([Maine Public](https://substack.com/redirect/5f194a99-fa62-4932-bd7e-0c88630b6143?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
**Collins tribal endorsement** : The Passamaquoddy Tribe at Sipayik endorsed Collins, the first tribal endorsement of her career, the Bangor Daily News reports. Chief Pos Bassett credited her with securing $5 million for a new wastewater plant after storm surges threatened the old one. Jackson has the Mi'kmaq Nation's backing from his governor run and is pitching tribal sovereignty; Collins has not joined that fight the way he has. ([BDN](https://substack.com/redirect/f378a07c-6c2c-4890-a296-0a4ac9537c6a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))

## Around the Web
**[Bobby Charles levels unfounded corruption claims at Hannah Pingree in final debate](https://substack.com/redirect/40987a88-cbd1-46c3-8f2e-ea22d60d1f00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Bangor Daily News) The last governor's debate, an hour on WMTW Wednesday night, opened with Republican Bobby Charles saying Democrat Hannah Pingree "boldly violated the public trust, conspiring with Janet Mills to enrich her family." His case rests on two nonprofits tied to films made by her husband, Jason Mann: an $840,000 forgivable MaineHousing loan to a North Haven housing group Mann now leads, and a roughly $38,000 grant from her old office to the Island Institute. Pingree says she had nothing to do with the housing award, and the Island Institute says none of its grant went to Mann's film. Pingree called Charles a "25-year lobbyist" and kept tying him to Trump. Charles said he has never met the president. Independent Rick Bennett, polling in the single digits, mostly couldn't get a word in: "It's not really a debate. It's more like who can outshout each other." Pingree, who has led every public poll since June, turned down the WABI/WAGM debate that Charles and Bennett both agreed to ([WAGM](https://substack.com/redirect/58e8ef51-fc76-4e2a-bcb9-ff793363f0f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which also has the full replay).
**[In Bangor, Mike Johnson calls Paul LePage's race 'top 5' in the country](https://substack.com/redirect/660e7fb0-8e39-4782-b313-fe0bed9c77ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Bangor Daily News) The Speaker's second trip to Maine for LePage, this time at Sea Dog Brewing. He called the 2nd District "a top five race in America right now." Decision Desk HQ gives Democrats a 77% chance of taking the House but has LePage at 61% against Dunlap. The super PAC aligned with Johnson is moving $10 million into 16 districts, Maine's 2nd among them, and Republicans lead the ad spending here $13.5 million to $10.1 million. LePage said he wants to be "the only Republican out of New England" in the House. Dunlap's campaign called him a "rubber stamp." [Our video from the event is here](https://substack.com/redirect/bd1e1609-4d5e-47de-a364-54d2b1e90315?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**[Maine hospital faces termination from Medicare due to lack of infection control](https://substack.com/redirect/e35feb0b-bbbc-4619-bc93-abf6d09bbbf1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Maine Public, via BDN) State inspectors at Central Maine Medical Center in Lewiston found surgical trays contaminated with an unidentified orange or yellow substance. Staff told them the problem had been known for three years. The board met 13 times between July 2025 and July 2026 and never discussed infection control. CMS says the hospital is still out of compliance and could be cut off from Medicare by Jan. 6. CMMC says there's no evidence any instrument used on a patient was contaminated.
**[CMP sues Maine over grid incentive dispute](https://substack.com/redirect/5de17a7a-7a51-487c-a279-486a6d0f0df2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (NEWS CENTER Maine) CMP gets a bonus from federal regulators for voluntarily belonging to ISO New England, the regional grid operator. This year the Legislature made membership mandatory, and the state says that means no more bonus. State agencies testified that dropping it would save ratepayers more than $2 million. CMP filed a federal lawsuit on Oct. 9 to block the law. So CMP is suing to keep getting paid for volunteering to do something that's now the law.
**[South Portland will vote on emergency ICE ordinance](https://substack.com/redirect/8aa17199-c75a-4019-b19c-9a8c94287ddb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (Portland Press Herald) The council plans an emergency ordinance on Oct. 27 that would bar city employees, police included, from voluntarily helping immigration enforcement, and it wants it on the books before Election Day. Portland, Lewiston, Rockland and Waterville already have rules like this, and Biddeford may vote Oct. 20. Councilor Carter Scott said it's worth doing "if it gives people in our community 1% less fear and 1% more hope." It's an emergency, apparently.

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE**
**October 15, 2026** **WESTFIELD, IN** - The **Spartz** campaign is reporting another wave of stolen **Victoria Spartz** campaign signs and unauthorized placement of anti-**Spartz** and **J.D. Ford** campaign signs. Large **Spartz** campaign signs have been stolen again. Hostile signs featuring the Congresswoman’s name crossed out, along with **J.D. Ford** campaign signs, have been placed in public rights-of-way and on private properties without owners’ permission. These incidents have been reported to law enforcement and local government officials. “I’ve been through a lot of campaigns, but I’ve never seen supporters as obnoxious and disrespectful of the law as **J.D. Ford** ’s. It’s no surprise, given **Ford** ’s record of voting to defund the police and backing rioters who looted businesses in Indianapolis, which he just moved from to run for this office,” said Congresswoman **Victoria Spartz**. “Theft, criminal trespass, intimidation, and lawlessness have no place in our communities.” Anyone with information about these incidents is encouraged to contact the **Spartz** campaign at [info@spartzforcongress.com](mailto:info@spartzforcongress.com).

Peter, we have an

seized Ilhan’s phone and subpoenaed multiple family members. Then, the
truth behind this political revenge plot was revealed:

officials and other people familiar with the probe."

Their end goal is to strip Ilhan of her citizenship and deport her to a
country she fled two decades ago as a refugee with her family at the age
of 12.

If they can persecute a sitting member of Congress like this for simply
disagreeing with her political stances, they can do it to any of us.

She comes to this country and says she has constitutional rights, has a
constitutional right to be in this country. They’re not even countries.
They don’t have anything. Then they come over here and tell us how we
should run the United States of America. No, thank you.”

These are the words and actions of a right-wing

There were more than 20 candidates in the field, and one of them had spent over 20 years building his name inside the establishment. Plenty of people had already decided how this would end._You/Our supporters didn 't listen to them._ You/they helped us gather more than **28,000** signatures to get us on the primary election ballot. I'm telling you this because I want you to see what I see right now. **We can flip a deep blue state in one election, and I want to show you exactly how.** Nearly half of Colorado's unaffiliated voters are already with us. Only 15% say they won't vote for me. clean_body: We can flip this deep blue state in one election, and I want to show you exactly how. | | | | | | | Friend, When I got into this race, I had a 4% chance of winning the primary. There were more than 20 candidates in the field, and one of them had spent over 20 years building his name inside the establishment. Plenty of people had already decided how this would end.You/Our supporters didn 't listen to them. You/they helped us gather more than 28,000 signatures to get us on the primary election ballot. You/they helped raise nearly $3 million in the primary alone, more than ten times what my opponents raised.And even though it took days to call the race after the June 30th election, we eventually were declared the winner -- proving everyone else wrong. I'm telling you this because I want you to see what I see right now. We can flip a deep blue state in one election, and I want to show you exactly how. Nearly half of Colorado's unaffiliated voters are already with us. Only 15% say they won't vote for me. The other 38% haven't made up their minds. To win, I need 58% of those unaffiliated voters. Our numbers put us at 46% today.So the governor's office comes down to about 12 points, and the people behind those points are still listening. Here's what gives me so much hope. When we asked undecided voters what was holding them back, 78% said they simply need more information or more time before they decide. They haven't heard my story yet. They don't know where I come from or why I'm running. We can fix that; But the window is closing fast. Ballots are landing in mailboxes across Colorado right now, and 95% of Coloradans vote by mail. Many ballots come back well before Election Day, which means we need to reach these voters right now, before they sit down at the kitchen table and make their choice. Every gift goes toward one goal: getting my story in front of the people who will decide this race, whether that's a mailer in their hands or a volunteer at their front door. I've spent my life stepping in when others said the odds were too long. You've done the same thing with me since the very first day of this campaign, and it's why we're standing here with a real shot at winning. The middle is open. Thank you for believing in this, and for every prayer you've sent my way. | | | For Colorado, Victor Marx GOP Nominee for Governor of Colorado P.S. 38% of unaffiliated voters are still undecided, and most of them just need to hear the story. # [Korea crashes 8% into bear market as AI debt fears go global](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
US futures slipped as the AI-trade unwind spread worldwide, **[sending Korea's Kospi into a bear market](https://substack.com/redirect/cfdbcadf-dc4e-484e-ad6e-d82f5b2a6160?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cfdbcadf-dc4e-484e-ad6e-d82f5b2a6160?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with circuit breakers activated while **[Treasury yields fell sharply](https://substack.com/redirect/e6bba78e-3bd9-42a2-b5e5-390a5aad5cd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/e6bba78e-3bd9-42a2-b5e5-390a5aad5cd2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)on growth fears.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Kospi enters bear** : The index plunged 7.6%, triggering Level 1 circuit breakers for the first time since July 29, with Samsung down 9.5% and SK Hynix off 11.1%.
* **US open mixed** : The Dow rose while the S&P and Nasdaq fell as semiconductors headed for an eighth straight down day, the longest streak since 2008.
* **Yields plunge** : Ten-year yields dropped more than 10 basis points to the lowest level in weeks as investors sought safety amid the risk-off move.
* **Inflation heat** : September PPI rose 1.3% month-over-month, the fastest since 2022, yet bonds rallied on concerns over growth and financing.

# [CoreWeave bonds hit 16% yields as AI debt panic spikes](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
CoreWeave[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/27a65f66-120c-4893-9f13-bf9ecf6f2d33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[shares and bonds sold off hard](https://substack.com/redirect/27a65f66-120c-4893-9f13-bf9ecf6f2d33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as yields pushed past distress levels, turning the Nvidia-backed neocloud into the face of worries that **[borrowed money is funding too much of the AI buildout.](https://substack.com/redirect/c59c01e6-5b90-4b5e-8465-e15efcccf255?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bond yields surge** : The 2031 notes yielded above 16% while five-year CDS climbed near 1,000 basis points, implying a roughly 63% chance of default within five years on about $50 billion of debt.
* **CEO pushes back** : Mike Intrator told staff the market "misunderstands and acts irrationally" and that the contract backlog more than supports all debt obligations.
* **Nvidia backstop** : The chip maker agreed to purchase any unsold capacity through April 2032, yet selling pressure continued.
* **Broader strain** : Oracle and other AI-related names also fell as investors scrutinized debt-funded expansion across the sector.

# [China accepts EU hybrid-vehicle cap to keep European markets open](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
China **[accepted an EU cap of 350,000 hybrid-vehicle imports a year](https://substack.com/redirect/d3fb36c5-251b-4e5e-b647-c5b1a1319050?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Beijing talks, a concession that shows how much it needs Europe as other markets close.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ed6da644-71ca-4e92-ab27-a89ef6cf8e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* **Broader package** : Talks also covered lower Chinese duties on EU goods and smoother rare-earth licensing as Beijing buys time.
* **Europe 's push**: Leaders meet in Brussels Thursday and are expected to press for further curbs, potentially extending to chemicals.

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: What it takes to grow something
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261015-6839-footer&t=1001&akid=6839%2E420207%2EpnyVhc ]Pramila Jayapal

Peter,

One of my absolute favorite things to do is spend time in my garden.

Recently, I cut dahlias I’ve been growing in my backyard. Being in my
garden surrounded by all of the beautiful flowers and greenery, I felt
pure peace and joy!

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261015-1.r_4cj-&refcode=em20261015-6839&t=1002&akid=6839%2E420207%2EpnyVhc ][IMG]

I’ve put in so much work nurturing these wonderful flowers — and thinking
about that really made me pause for a second.

I think about it a lot, actually — what it takes to grow something. You
can’t rush it. You have to show up, consistently, even when nothing seems
to be happening. You water, you tend, and you wait. And then one day,
something beautiful blooms that wasn’t there before.

That’s what we’re doing here,
Peter, because growing a garden
is a lot like growing a movement.

Our movement didn’t sprout overnight. It was born out of our collective
resistance. It grew from the soil that is our community. Organizing
together, showing up, refusing to give in for years, even when the ground
felt dry and progress felt slow. We’ve never given up.

30,000+ people trained in nonviolent resistance. Progressive candidates
winning races across the country against millions in dark money. A
people-powered movement that is strong, determined, and continuing to grow
each day.

That is what sustained, grounded, and committed organizing looks like.
Just like a garden, you don’t just plant the seeds and walk away. You
nurture it. You protect it. You come back to it every single day, and
trust that the work you’re putting in right now will bloom into something
extraordinary.

I want you to think about that every time you feel discouraged. Every time
the headlines get too loud and you start to lose hope. Think of these
dahlias, think of every seed we’ve sprouted across this movement, and take
a moment to fill yourself up with beauty. Know that there’s a whole
movement of fighters standing right alongside you, and we are going to
win.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261015-1.r_4cj-&refcode=em20261015-6839&t=1003&akid=6839%2E420207%2EpnyVhc ][IMG]

We’re in the final stretch to Election Day — and the moment we’ve been
working towards is almost here. But I need you with me to finish strong.

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261015-1.r_4cj-&refcode=em20261015-6839&amount=3&t=1004&akid=6839%2E420207%2EpnyVhc ]If you can, will you please pitch in $3, or whatever is
meaningful to you today to help us reach our $18,000 mid-month goal and
keep growing this movement all the way to November?

[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20261015-1.r_4cj-&amount=3&refcode=em20261015-6839&t=1023&akid=6839%2E420207%2EpnyVhc ]Contribute $3

In solidarity,

Pramila Jayapal

Less than three weeks until Election Day| | | |
---
| | | Friends and Supporters, We’re less than three weeks out from Election Day and we’re getting ready to put our Get Out The Vote program into motion. It’s hard to believe that after a year’s worth of incredible efforts by an incredible team, we’re finally here in the closing stretch. Last week my opponent Michael Alfonso and I met in Duluth (that’s in Minnesota) for our only televised debate. We’ve had a pile of invitations for debates and I’ve accepted all of them, but Michael and his team have embraced a novel political strategy: saying as little as possible in front of the cameras with just weeks before an election.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141489667/653729267/135284428?refcode=newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMjEwMzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzllODlmNGUtYmZjOC1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DURIeJwKK7gZ2zQij-wa06X0Dta2tlirX78afRLe9NI=)
---
So their high-priced consultants have had them turning down debate invitations, leaving requests to attend events unanswered, not returning calls from journalists, or as happened at a healthcare forum the week before our debate, simply deciding not to show up to a confirmed appearance. It seems they’ve decided the risks of talking in front of a camera are much greater than the risks of not talking to anybody. Think about what that means! I’ll spend the last weeks of this election doing what I’ve done all along: continuing to make my case directly to you and your neighbors about what we need in our next Congress. You may see me in person at events in your community or popping up in your social media feed. You might want to attend the virtual rally we’re holding on October 20th (see below for more information) - I hope that you do! Thanks to your incredible generosity, we hit our fundraising goals out of the park this month, and so some of you in the Wausau area will be seeing me in ads on your TV in the next few weeks. Because you have believed so strongly in our campaign, we have been able to achieve things that months ago we would have considered nearly out of reach. And we are not done yet! The energy is building each day and more and more people are joining the Clark for Wisconsin team. Of all of the things that this campaign has accomplished, I am most proud that it is truly driven by people who care about their neighbors and the future of northern Wisconsin.
---

clean_body: Less than three weeks until Election Day| | | | | | | Friends and Supporters, We’re less than three weeks out from Election Day and we’re getting ready to put our Get Out The Vote program into motion. It’s hard to believe that after a year’s worth of incredible efforts by an incredible team, we’re finally here in the closing stretch. Last week my opponent Michael Alfonso and I met in Duluth (that’s in Minnesota) for our only televised debate. We’ve had a pile of invitations for debates and I’ve accepted all of them, but Michael and his team have embraced a novel political strategy: saying as little as possible in front of the cameras with just weeks before an election. = So their high-priced consultants have had them turning down debate invitations, leaving requests to attend events unanswered, not returning calls from journalists, or as happened at a healthcare forum the week before our debate, simply deciding not to show up to a confirmed appearance. It seems they’ve decided the risks of talking in front of a camera are much greater than the risks of not talking to anybody. Think about what that means! I’ll spend the last weeks of this election doing what I’ve done all along: continuing to make my case directly to you and your neighbors about what we need in our next Congress. You may see me in person at events in your community or popping up in your social media feed. You might want to attend the virtual rally we’re holding on October 20th (see below for more information) - I hope that you do! Thanks to your incredible generosity, we hit our fundraising goals out of the park this month, and so some of you in the Wausau area will be seeing me in ads on your TV in the next few weeks. Because you have believed so strongly in our campaign, we have been able to achieve things that months ago we would have considered nearly out of reach. And we are not done yet! The energy is building each day and more and more people are joining the Clark for Wisconsin team. Of all of the things that this campaign has accomplished, I am most proud that it is truly driven by people who care about their neighbors and the future of northern Wisconsin. = We welcome you to join us as we work together to win on November 3rd.Fred | | | | Get Fred Clark on TV! = All our bills are paid and now every dollar donated goes to getting our ad on TV. = | Events Mary Mack Comedy Show Saturday, October 17, 6pmWhite Winter Mead, Iron River, WI Virtual Rally with Fred -, October 20, 7 pmJoin Fred and some special guests as we count down to Election Day! Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to flip Congress in 19 days. If you need help checking your voter registration or making a plan to vote, please visit [iwillvote.com](https://ak.democrats.org/go/9784?t=2&akid=9902%2E22930333%2EodUs1y). _**The weak department?**_ I enlisted in the Marine Corps right out of high school. I made sergeant, then spent decades in the Army and retired as a Brigadier General. After 9/11, I led infantry soldiers in combat in Afghanistan. In 2014, I took a team into Liberia while Ebola was killing thousands, because that was the mission and somebody had to go. **I never served with a single weak person in 40 years.** Not the young soldiers who walked patrols knowing what could be waiting for them. Not the medics, mechanics, and cooks who kept us alive and moving. Not the military families who held everything together at home while we were gone. So who does Pete Hegseth think he is? **Our armed forces have never been weak. Not under any president or any party. Those men and women were strong long before he got a podium, and they'll be strong long after he's gone.** Northwest Georgia is full of veterans and military families who know that truth. They deserve a representative who will stand up and say it proudly. Right now, Clay Fuller holds this seat, and I haven't heard him say a word. On November 3, I'm asking voters to send someone to Congress who knows what our troops are made of, because I served with them. **We have 29 days left. Every dollar helps us get this message on TV screens, in mailboxes, and on veterans' doors across the district before Election Day. So I am asking: Can you chip in $25 right now to send a veteran to Congress who will stand up to Pete Hegseth?**

**Peter, it’s John James. **
We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. _I promise I will not waste your time._
I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted.
I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, _**I would live it.**_
[**Eventually, this led me to apply to West Point, and my decision to serve my country would make me the man I am today.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=a8d1a6e08d4f441c95f73469ac42ac75&_e=QJGLcXbFEFqZYRVWnjbjjtY0pzeT65Or4kSOyIKl3mdIeGz7fGmmAVPgoMFa9VF18To6Id_JTzZs6GGNN1Ok7pTaacV1Kqj_QIl-RNgi-x8RBSRvNQYedFvzUbYkgJgBCOGaTUjzN_fCe09iZDyeFPWsw9DsQFjQNv5flsvK9-H1iHN0_Xuaqu9aCw5e1tV2S7gyBBEas4kllf1tUnTFnijW-3_oVvQdyDF-A6ejKZm2NoY34kRDTWSf2TVqIJw8fd6u8vfZ8SEEszQzwFfGmJe1m6uDn0CATwfIBuytUqcGOwKwrBPodExVr7keDEfoVVeRLYcbYOB0OUTWbs-q4TSZA7Dr-pMQhGQ-mBZizr1McwQdRnXO2xplWoXMjQFtMV2oF8EFAVFoeSd7goMlgxqDt8JciT8ngn7nKRNDswcidQTmUI7TPos9YIlSH1gHkv5Lh-4EZ8mSfNE8OpGYwv13PJsr3L6qcUqrTovgMC9hSiGtlazMGAkTinBXH6k8QwSPKQKtw7mvRcicE3BZSB40jttVyImjP56sK9xe3tBkLdn4hx7ym569dL7Km3tvU_KFKDMQLZdptM5n_ic1P_unfylRl3ZpqI-F8XajxHB1symxHZT7KyCX_xcdTvUOSs4tuotipNk_CgoNKnHtFhHnWdc1kNoKPvmL4sjE_Ne9dZP_7FVp-4hMzQtg-uZDu-wb4A984_mUcAGs55gRq8P4Egqr6JhjbOcvNVkAtCTrL0UY8ltX7QmHnv96Urpb)

Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army.
During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. **Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. **
**I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and _I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud._**

After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, **_I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. _**
I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician...
[**But there comes a point in your life when you stop looking at the issues surrounding you and start thinking about what you can do to fix them.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=a8d1a6e08d4f441c95f73469ac42ac75&_e=QJGLcXbFEFqZYRVWnjbjjtY0pzeT65Or4kSOyIKl3mdIeGz7fGmmAVPgoMFa9VF18To6Id_JTzZs6GGNN1Ok7pTaacV1Kqj_QIl-RNgi-x8RBSRvNQYedFvzUbYkgJgBCOGaTUjzN_fCe09iZDyeFPWsw9DsQFjQNv5flsvK9-H1iHN0_Xuaqu9aCw5e1tV2S7gyBBEas4kllf1tUnTFnijW-3_oVvQdyDF-A6ejKZm2NoY34kRDTWSf2TVqIJw8fd6u8vfZ8SEEszQzwFfGmCxYr3_xaNMsbYORR7tyOPA5a84nSAnruGD18rmTgqwtLTdVen6LMhqNLDvPUOG_8cIAUVxL6pWJA-VzUfUaaqyH-ptf3LAHQnU6c8ZKnXBK41WwRGhPWgkMXMXILxNY9UJ-_moYgThRDbNh_yh2zdFJqY0cmE0BnEW3EiEySjRoGl89MBl12nq3Qxoc4IW8YR5wlqM6I50vaSDX_T63EJYwdt_UGuoNPMRrQ3-ltYcI2S9JhcKcmC8DG3e8AODfimb22YH8eBXGugJvnS3EDRKyCgHESAnRQC1AmQZwOzssx_uzdWpIsdYcKIppvV2vOJwFwe2MTks2BTcpc59kaeFY-fuBEHvmPoohJvNo8iyKwEwHl8ly9RZ8QZIg7N4cBTUudm9-TzLW-Td6Ha6f_Lo4j0KffXaLy1rtveSnUb6GBBzykUEqtRt5IrnE27VTVHENmm0R5Bb93WH50yOjBoi3GZ07Q6DuSw2FDqdKLF9u)

I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. **I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents.** Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, _I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024.__ _ **Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate.** My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, __but they’re not my #1 reason why...__
