clean_body: I’m a combat veteran and a father. I hope you will read this.| | | | | Peter, it’s John James. We're less than 3 weeks away from Election Day. Before I say anything else—as someone who has logged 750 combat hours in Iraq—I know every second counts, and there’s not a moment in the day we should be wasting. I promise I will not waste your time. I just want to tell you a little about myself; it’s about time we got well-acquainted. I was born and raised in Michigan, and throughout high school, I felt a deep-rooted call to service. I decided I wouldn’t just read about service in the magazines, I would live it. Graduating from West Point was just the beginning of my eight years in the United States Army. During Operation Iraqi Freedom, I led Apache Helicopter Platoons, and I feel like I spent more time in the air than I did on the ground. Some nights, I didn’t know if I’d make it through the next day, and every mission I flew, I went into the unknown. Throughout my service, I had the honor of receiving a Combat Action Badge and two Air Medals. I wouldn’t trade my time in the service for anything, but I’ll be honest, it was good coming home, and I can rest easy knowing I did my country proud. After coming back stateside, I swapped my fatigues for a suit. I took over the family business, creating jobs here in Michigan and earning a master’s in supply chain management from Penn State and an MBA from the University of Michigan. I was never one to rest, and after making so many life-or-death decisions in Iraq, I knew every second mattered; I wanted to make the most of my time for my family and me. I never for a second considered running for office, and the last thing I’d consider myself is a politician... I saw the Democrats destroying our country, and I knew my service to this great nation wasn’t over yet. Everybody told me running for office isn’t easy, but my heart was telling me it was the right thing to do. I won my election, with the help of President Trump, and started delivering results for my new constituents. Then, in 2023, when the Establishment tried to move on from Trump and being MAGA was seen as risky or politically inconvenient, I was among the first in Michigan to endorse President Trump for 2024. Loyalty isn’t a talking point to me; it’s the only way I know how to operate. My dedication to this country, my loyalty towards my constituents, and my desire to see the greatest nation on earth excel are part of the reasons why I’m now emailing you, but they’re not my #1 reason why... These three kids are the reason why I’m sending this message to you, as a TRUMP-ENDORSED Republican and father running to be the next governor of Michigan Having my own family taught me more lessons than I could list, and it was the one thing being in the U.S. Army didn’t prepare me for. But it also awoke in me a desire to do EVERYTHING and ANYTHING I can to ensure my kids have bright futures. My family means everything to me, and Michigan is our home; that’s why I will fight like my life depends on it to save this state and win this November. I’m under no illusions; I know this election will be one of the toughest challenges I’ve faced in my entire life, but after everything I’ve done in my service, it’s nothing I can’t handle. Unfortunately, the one thing I can’t directly control is spending, and the Democrats will do everything in their power to stop my campaign from making it to the ballot box this November. Nothing can stop us from saving this country if we stand together. Today, I’m asking you to make a small-dollar gift of $10, $25, $50 or ANYTHING you can spare to fuel my campaign’s fight as we approach our upcoming November 3rd election. Thank you for taking the time to read my message. I hope to hear from you in the days to come. name: Kristan Hawkins
subject: James Talarico couldn’t help himself when he got in front of cameras
body:
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=55305a50bc534f2a8d8133bdea64352f&_e=HUISDASlQbRgSXcYYZjMztMvUPr0_jE1w2R15Jxr0NT29LQD-dcov8dG3oG60s5iBRu_Q_c8DClvaXvYPQB_Hdovo_CVbZg6ptUk2t3tHRnDQR33gWccykpnV-NY46w03ppJx1dIVhI5540IOV4J-4RAXNHL384uGjY23t9cX9tI1PeUQKmprbYoUyP_sbQgI8RHzShkSy6YOaskhLgIXZOzrk7ZpfLaVjKXjd7DTnXUgCNlrk12U4btJoSRctb_clz6z8oZy4P-yxpzupJavs5IBsNNYTMXujooaaEpDqe6WCpQXAsjNfB9Vc7KZ8jBVUkAF_6yzCU-ERtLbFgiZqrJn8sGd69L-0pt11czXLOhcRAVhq8sqOgDOCn-XzuUjsoDjlho1ya9Mg4Cq9wM-jp8Ko0y8VselmsUpQsK2mit-5dnyjzhNmIPWNSZuK02sSxVJUK_In5ebY6B1q6XubuPt1pCCqtZrlbbg-NqJpqueLtp-CHx_3xFVXK0nYCW2HKp8lUCuMb982-wjSi_b5opGFrUTpfYQFvlMjdT8K6cjxIDgyKQsJ-aWUh9kmft5zZzO6786DwMIX_DNULReJIpGyxwhZ3ObCOsqmRWPRP2ODOwOp9dTKNXg3Y29mZ0)

Hi Pro-Life Friend,

As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip.

When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color.

That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters.

Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version.

And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Dear Pro-Life Friend, here's my problem.

You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism.

So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable.
That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races.

[Will you please chip in right now to keep our rapid response team ready to move the moment we get word of the next public event](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=55305a50bc534f2a8d8133bdea64352f&_e=HUISDASlQbRgSXcYYZjMztMvUPr0_jE1w2R15Jxr0NT29LQD-dcov8dG3oG60s5iBRu_Q_c8DClvaXvYPQB_Hdovo_CVbZg6ptUk2t3tHRnDQR33gWccykpnV-NY46w0OQ7_yGxVaDILgYP6i9VW0qFt0Ae5CIozs2hAeDOlyalvQyxzinUuVqgtqvih_tczSmgnvzFz_RvLlBYGCv2oRyc3u2w2ACT2d3iTikbQPGGzzo-SEU4WguGhTrzUphJ6NruQ5NO7ORAmthW6f4M0J_pem4_tTrJoFl8CxzBz1-PETtjcqHqjT0aap-dYNWFBvD-7hst5ml7LCHYad2j6S5O2qf-JWnFsukn77CpH94k2vnhW4rLhvlbYvFmZxEu9E_vHX4wyZqBapobXt_8GL-jJZhRVAZ5gZdDjfQrYTPrWIrtMNdu2Eg-W-Pj9TZCLmWWM3JTB1iWHAf2tMb2jWfIKyvlg9jX1raaCkEFyXR817AFqD6BJfTqhudvGm4jGxALfqSB10rtlsLB1jMXuRUkuwN_TSerKrEX61g_czIv8shDA9hYiwnnKq_shva6btlAw4XeN44NZGjN9HZ0Mtsna_x4VI6MFPjA-FONyuc2loAkAEgsNrmZ1auib6iO5oWskVJiQnwLk0ILq8V7LFw%3D%3D)**?**

Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard.

Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance.

Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it?

A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally."

I've seen it time and time again.

These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election.

One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle.

Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out.

So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after.

That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own.

None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline.

clean_body: Hi Pro-Life Friend, As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip. When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color. That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media. Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters. Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version. And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months. My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement. Dear Pro-Life Friend, here's my problem. You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism. So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable. That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races. ? Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard. Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance. Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it? A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally." I've seen it time and time again. These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election. One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle. Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out. So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after. That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own. None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline. ? * * *
I was back on NewsNation last night, in person from the great city of Chicago, to debate the midterms and the state of the economy with my buddy Leland Vittert. Across from me was self-proclaimed "Trumpocrat" and former Illinois governor Rod Blagojevich. Something happened in the middle of that segment that I haven't been able to shake, and I want to talk to you about it.
**For those of you who don 't remember Rod Blagojevich, let me remind you who this guy is.**
**He was the Democratic governor of Illinois who got caught trying to essentially sell Barack Obama 's vacant Senate seat after Obama won the presidency in 2008. Blagojevich had the power to appoint Obama's replacement, and instead of treating that responsibility as a public trust, he saw an opportunity to get something for himself.**
**He was also convicted in a corruption case involving an attempt to pressure a children 's hospital executive for campaign contributions. **
**He was convicted on multiple federal corruption charges and sentenced to** _**14 years**_**in prison. This was a governor abusing the power of his office for personal and political gain.**
**And then Donald Trump came along.**
**In 2020, Trump commuted Blagojevich 's sentence after he'd served about eight years, letting him walk out of prison roughly six years early. Then, in February 2025, Trump went even further and gave him a full and unconditional pardon.**
**Think about that for a second.**
**A man who tried to use his public office as something he could trade for personal benefit was rescued from prison by Donald Trump. And now that same man was sitting across from me on national television, defending the president who let him out.**
When the conversation turned to the war in Iran, Blagojevich ~~a man convicted on numerous fraud charges and later pardoned by Donald Trump,~~ started parroting MAGA talking points almost word for word. The economy was great before the war, he said, but Iran was so determined to get a nuclear weapon that Trump had no choice but to step in and spare the world from a nuclear Iran.
That is complete and total bullshit. Tulsi Gabbard, Donald Trump's own Director of National Intelligence, confirmed Iran was nowhere near having a nuclear weapon. This was a war of choice, plain and simple -- and the economy sucked before the war.
So in that moment, I chose to push back pretty damn hard. I called Blagojevich out for repeating the Republican line because Donald Trump gave him a pardon.
Because that's the deal. Pardons don't just set people free anymore. They buy loyalty. You can commit a crime, **abuse your power** **and betray the public 's trust, and** do basically whatever you want, and if you know the right person, if you've got enough money to put in the right back pocket, you get a get-out-of-jail-free card.
The price is that you spend the rest of your life defending the guy who gave it to you. Rod Blagojevich is the proof.
This is a man who is still barred from holding public office in Illinois because of the crimes he committed. And yet he's been welcomed into the MAGA movement and right-wing media circles with open arms, because he's useful to them. He gets to pretend he's still a Democrat, when in reality he's a single-issue voter. And that single issue is keeping himself out of prison.

* * *
The people watching at home deserve to know that~~' s what's going on~~. They deserve to know why this guy is saying what he's saying. **So you know damn well, I wasn 't **going to sit there and let it slide.
It's especially infuriating right now, when this country is really struggling. The economy is a disaster, and this week's inflation numbers are horrible -- **back up to 3.7 percent.** **Gas prices are up more than 34 percent from a year ago. And nearly half a million bankruptcy cases have been filed in the first nine months of this year alone, up 11 percent from the same period last year.**
The war in Iran is spiraling out of control, and the only reason it isn't even worse right now is that Trump is waiting until after the midterms to start bombing again, **when he no longer feels he has to worry about voters delivering an immediate political reckoning.**
These are the moments when Americans most need straight answers. **But instead,** **we 're** **being gaslit with** talking points from people with a personal stake in keeping Trump happy.
Too much of the media treats all of it like a game. Like it's ESPN breaking down the tale of the tape, instead of just being honest about what's happening. The "I'm a Trumpocrat, I don't recognize the Democratic Party" routine gets played as if it were a real perspective, when it's really just garbage.
It does a real disservice to the people sitting at home. **Look** , the average American may not be as politically engaged as I am. Most people are just trying to pay their bills, and figure out who's actually on their side. That's incredibly hard to do when you can't trust a single word coming out of the mouths of so many of these MAGA influencers.
**And this brings me back to the title of this piece: The price of Trump 's pardons.**
**For the people receiving them, the price is loyalty. You get your freedom, your reputation gets rehabilitated, and in return, you 're expected to defend the man who made it possible.**
**But the price for the rest of us is something much bigger.**
**It 's the idea that justice is supposed to mean something in this country. That if you abuse your public office, you will be held accountble. That the law applies to the powerful just as surely as it applies to the rest of us.**
**And it 's the ability to turn on the television and hear an honest argument about what's happening in this country without having to wonder what the person making it owes the president.**
**That 's what we're losing. And once that trust is gone, it's a hell of a lot harder to get back than it was to destroy.**
I'll end this the way I've ended a lot of these pieces lately, because I think it's the most important point:
The level of corruption, criminality, self-dealing, and self-interest we're living through in America today is unprecedented. That means the solutions to make sure it never happens again have to be unprecedented too. I never once thought about reforming the presidential pardon power until I watched Donald Trump turn it into a way to buy loyalty, and then watched one of the people he bought sit across from me on live TV.
Now I can't stop thinking about it, and how to prepare the Democratic Party for the many uncomfortable decisions that need to be made to make sure this never happens again.
With urgency,
--Mike

Former Illinois Governor Rod Blagojevich sat across from me on NewsNation last night and showed America exactly what Trump's pardons buy. | | | Oct 15 | | | | | | | | | | | | Already a paid subscriber? Then like, share, and keep showing up in the comments. It matters more than you know. I was back on NewsNation last night, in person from the great city of Chicago, to debate the midterms and the state of the economy with my buddy Leland Vittert. Across from me was self-proclaimed "Trumpocrat" and former Illinois governor Rod Blagojevich. Something happened in the middle of that segment that I haven't been able to shake, and I want to talk to you about it. For those of you who don 't remember Rod Blagojevich, let me remind you who this guy is. He was the Democratic governor of Illinois who got caught trying to essentially sell Barack Obama 's vacant Senate seat after Obama won the presidency in 2008. Blagojevich had the power to appoint Obama's replacement, and instead of treating that responsibility as a public trust, he saw an opportunity to get something for himself. He was also convicted in a corruption case involving an attempt to pressure a children 's hospital executive for campaign contributions. He was convicted on multiple federal corruption charges and sentenced to 14 yearsin prison. This was a governor abusing the power of his office for personal and political gain. And then Donald Trump came along. In 2020, Trump commuted Blagojevich 's sentence after he'd served about eight years, letting him walk out of prison roughly six years early. Then, in February 2025, Trump went even further and gave him a full and unconditional pardon. Think about that for a second. A man who tried to use his public office as something he could trade for personal benefit was rescued from prison by Donald Trump. And now that same man was sitting across from me on national television, defending the president who let him out. When the conversation turned to the war in Iran, Blagojevich ~~a man convicted on numerous fraud charges and later pardoned by Donald Trump,~~ started parroting MAGA talking points almost word for word. The economy was great before the war, he said, but Iran was so determined to get a nuclear weapon that Trump had no choice but to step in and spare the world from a nuclear Iran. That is complete and total bullshit. Tulsi Gabbard, Donald Trump's own Director of National Intelligence, confirmed Iran was nowhere near having a nuclear weapon. This was a war of choice, plain and simple -- and the economy sucked before the war. So in that moment, I chose to push back pretty damn hard. I called Blagojevich out for repeating the Republican line because Donald Trump gave him a pardon. Because that's the deal. Pardons don't just set people free anymore. They buy loyalty. You can commit a crime, abuse your power and betray the public 's trust, and do basically whatever you want, and if you know the right person, if you've got enough money to put in the right back pocket, you get a get-out-of-jail-free card. The price is that you spend the rest of your life defending the guy who gave it to you. Rod Blagojevich is the proof. This is a man who is still barred from holding public office in Illinois because of the crimes he committed. And yet he's been welcomed into the MAGA movement and right-wing media circles with open arms, because he's useful to them. He gets to pretend he's still a Democrat, when in reality he's a single-issue voter. And that single issue is keeping himself out of prison. The people watching at home deserve to know that~~' s what's going on~~. They deserve to know why this guy is saying what he's saying. So you know damn well, I wasn 't going to sit there and let it slide. It's especially infuriating right now, when this country is really struggling. The economy is a disaster, and this week's inflation numbers are horrible -- back up to 3.7 percent. Gas prices are up more than 34 percent from a year ago. And nearly half a million bankruptcy cases have been filed in the first nine months of this year alone, up 11 percent from the same period last year. The war in Iran is spiraling out of control, and the only reason it isn't even worse right now is that Trump is waiting until after the midterms to start bombing again, when he no longer feels he has to worry about voters delivering an immediate political reckoning. These are the moments when Americans most need straight answers. But instead, we 're being gaslit with talking points from people with a personal stake in keeping Trump happy. Too much of the media treats all of it like a game. Like it's ESPN breaking down the tale of the tape, instead of just being honest about what's happening. The "I'm a Trumpocrat, I don't recognize the Democratic Party" routine gets played as if it were a real perspective, when it's really just garbage. It does a real disservice to the people sitting at home. Look , the average American may not be as politically engaged as I am. Most people are just trying to pay their bills, and figure out who's actually on their side. That's incredibly hard to do when you can't trust a single word coming out of the mouths of so many of these MAGA influencers. And this brings me back to the title of this piece: The price of Trump 's pardons. For the people receiving them, the price is loyalty. You get your freedom, your reputation gets rehabilitated, and in return, you 're expected to defend the man who made it possible. But the price for the rest of us is something much bigger. It 's the idea that justice is supposed to mean something in this country. That if you abuse your public office, you will be held accountble. That the law applies to the powerful just as surely as it applies to the rest of us. And it 's the ability to turn on the television and hear an honest argument about what's happening in this country without having to wonder what the person making it owes the president. That 's what we're losing. And once that trust is gone, it's a hell of a lot harder to get back than it was to destroy.** I'll end this the way I've ended a lot of these pieces lately, because I think it's the most important point: The level of corruption, criminality, self-dealing, and self-interest we're living through in America today is unprecedented. That means the solutions to make sure it never happens again have to be unprecedented too. I never once thought about reforming the presidential pardon power until I watched Donald Trump turn it into a way to buy loyalty, and then watched one of the people he bought sit across from me on live TV. Now I can't stop thinking about it, and how to prepare the Democratic Party for the many uncomfortable decisions that need to be made to make sure this never happens again. He 's the founder of Authentic.org, an award-winning fundraising and advertising agency, and a former Senior Advisor to Vice President Kamala Harris. **This year, ‘O Rew returned to Yurok hands**. Save the Redwoods completed a historic land transfer, returning 125 acres of ancestral land back to the Yurok Tribe. ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway is now open as the first Indigenous-owned visitor gateway to the redwoods. Said Yurok Tribal Chairman Joseph James: **“I believe [this project] is a leading example of what we need across the nation.”**
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/141492631/653738884/-2125630674?sourceid=1168921&ms=DR_EM4&utm_campaign=K2D-1168921&utm_source=ea-fundraising&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImNjMGRlMjcyLWM1YzgtZjExMS1iZjViLTAwMGQzYTRmYmU4MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=2u8BA1nXcjW9r_OYDcQVUj8J89XduPevBeXA_-A3gpQ=&emci=6e864150-40c7-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=cc0de272-c5c8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=1504551)

This was a year of major momentum for Redwoods Rising. This first-of-its-kind project is **breathing life back into damaged forests** that still bear scars from decades of industrial logging. clean_body: From ‘O Rew to Montgomery Woods and beyond| | | | | | Dear Peter, showcasing our impact, accomplishments, and what comes next. In case you missed it, let me share just a few of the highlights from the report, each of them made possible by our incredible community: This year, ‘O Rew returned to Yurok hands. Save the Redwoods completed a historic land transfer, returning 125 acres of ancestral land back to the Yurok Tribe. ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway is now open as the first Indigenous-owned visitor gateway to the redwoods. Said Yurok Tribal Chairman Joseph James: “I believe [this project] is a leading example of what we need across the nation.” This was a year of major momentum for Redwoods Rising. This first-of-its-kind project is breathing life back into damaged forests that still bear scars from decades of industrial logging. This year, 785 acres of degraded, previously logged forests were strategically thinned to accelerate old-growth conditions; 14 miles of decaying logging roads were removed; and nearly 4,000 feet of streams and aquatic habitats were restored. On Earth Day, Save the Redwoods League transferred the 453-acre Atkins Place property to Montgomery Woods State Natural Reserve, boosting the park’s size by 16%. This transfer is the culmination of years of work, as Save the Redwoods worked to secure protection of lands surrounding Montgomery Woods. State Park scan now explore expanding public access, connecting more people to the world-class views of Atkins Place. Eight years after originally purchasing the pristine Harold Richardson Redwoods Reserve, Save the Redwoods was able to expand the Reserve by 25% with the purchase of 200 acres of adjacent land. This acquisition serves as a protective buffer for the Reserve’s hundreds of irreplaceable old-growth coast redwoods, increasing wildfire resilience and opening the way for further recreational access to this ancient ecosystem. As you read, we could not do this work without you. In case you missed it, right now, thanks to the generosity of Redwoods Councilor Peggy Light, Your partnership is critical as we build on this exciting progress. Last mid-month of the election. The DCCC is celebrating early. Tonight’s number is how we respond. |

Fellow Conservative,

Tonight is our last mid-month fundraising deadline before Election Day.

That means something specific. We are at the halfway point of October. Nineteen days out from November 3rd. And tonight’s report is the last mid-month indicator either side gets before the votes are counted. It tells donors, outside groups, and the opposition exactly where this race stands heading into the final stretch.

I need it to say we are ready.

| [**TONIGHT’S NUMBER MATTERS >>**
](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=13ed4128f0d04e7eb9c7b31001d5bea2&_e=yNDAtL6lUUHu_JxVvA1Wo8fdPqGG10_aI8stOmeAK1_HMNoEVLL5uSFPXdRHKG5kh8-3HkfcjV9OPxWiXgPm_JX3sQdB5qJdHsE5tD-ATGRFZa4locfZ3oSzK4nTVdKEf0ZH1ZSwv9q6LFsCRkiJlpdRp_A-Ar0GO6rg3xp8Fs4YjRIEsPgLmOQAJbzUNyyZuzzLujoEV9MvL1J_WvMRGna9jpxlng0FU2WRZ51CdWV45CQarEfrTX3B66eCo5IONQeLsx1IXmLQ1lIHCDhn00203lfkA4zu7XGMTg2vyC-B-SA3ma75bpJhbX7xika3qd4THUdrHxHQzJv81Bvwk0adEZkdZhrCwJGGKSnNraBuqzbV1zHGjmXenXtxI6dMDYyNGqcsZ_sAgCvEpRDrmv6nLKbG7_BGBQ49YNazNo8q44NWCfJ6d-H2G1IA0adYOixm5Peq-np93HcqFfOp8wqsJIQAXtXWoOgk5WWZt7Y5se5g6QPBvW2bK9f7HqPbQmUuUxzhTLqtmIBM_9KdMCZkHVdlT5bmQFmE-5kB_FQ62Sa32fyp1p2Tp84kRKHKLrVI3WeSxozshp3Q2awwAjPmNEaHYlBYFrsDf3xIj2-T4etj6cmirsW6Vjzc7aYo1kZqkXCMhcYLAkK0oBt6GC8D2dUVkYx7BPAx3tccAM9x_f4JyRmLw0ctFP4OUEeAA35EbbAxLCHrgbwx7gTucO_QF_1q9Gcv57jSU4oU-wo%3D)
---

****_[Are we, Fellow Conservative?](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=13ed4128f0d04e7eb9c7b31001d5bea2&_e=yNDAtL6lUUHu_JxVvA1Wo8fdPqGG10_aI8stOmeAK1_HMNoEVLL5uSFPXdRHKG5kh8-3HkfcjV9OPxWiXgPm_JX3sQdB5qJdHsE5tD-ATGRFZa4locfZ3oSzK4nTVdKEf0ZH1ZSwv9q6LFsCRkiJlpdRp_A-Ar0GO6rg3xp8Fs4YjRIEsPgLmOQAJbzUNyyZuzzLujoEV9MvL1J_WvMRGna9jpxlng0FU2WRZ51CdWV45CQarEfrTX3B66eCo5IOEOJf_EixwjyT3e1zY5yYR12h--eZ7J1sqar82ApmFUHcXt1wDKcTne-sPl9FfvTQuteDVGKynGNSJIoDPNlZ0zIOl_xTPU5my3Wo-UU2hBUYtybcb5_KoErh4YOL_tWYjWpilAfa92IgAxEalC49fP5ehEuZdQLi350VC9_RyNKw761tefV4tJblnUA2X__X36ZmCDPUytE1qHtrIVOm22mw0QnWygWMZvwwO9_VlMWu9DSUSsB-wMdQM7pOkgN_AoZ3mzDEUzxulO4hvS7CQnhg5vLZmapVl8UfO7Bi0vSgJmOndFHAtP4JU051yLlIli4lb868a61zBJacVbYhci-i0g-WyQ2VYRhyjUEbMTKSXiOEyka6X2NU5QILd1fTfEYMi949INNBEudV2Vo45logdgsncYNzn8800srIgPd0f4jwFt5bpG-S_j1ZT4rhZdIl6XQOr0mK4jU2zW1MXXcyhO4Eke6goCLPk7DmRvk%3D)_** **

[**RUSH SUPPORT >>**
](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=13ed4128f0d04e7eb9c7b31001d5bea2&_e=yNDAtL6lUUHu_JxVvA1Wo8fdPqGG10_aI8stOmeAK1_HMNoEVLL5uSFPXdRHKG5kh8-3HkfcjV9OPxWiXgPm_JX3sQdB5qJdHsE5tD-ATGRFZa4locfZ3oSzK4nTVdKEf0ZH1ZSwv9q6LFsCRkiJlpdRp_A-Ar0GO6rg3xp8Fs4YjRIEsPgLmOQAJbzUNyyZuzzLujoEV9MvL1J_WvMRGna9jpxlng0FU2WRZ51CdWV45CQarEfrTX3B66eCo5IOGqrqHIz-oSyhOf91ivlaQdmf3NvQNk7JmLTB848CPiYzIN-noUPbkoiyL1AP6fnm3DYDYm86QZPGJ8DSpnSm5UJdABgrt-pGmzuJBoWbQuTDK0fUlXjTiIFd-P37GeCf2SUuHNXirO7xQ9holU-DfCQnrMDUASxIX_JLyovg9sC-hegaUvyDlg5DdZHBw_6qOjztstrRljiTl6vmnptgtMix8vWxMYsxnTy3ZzQMkvxYLQDXSYg0aoj92HOwyilsStC2pU7Rt7v59nGSSPVjWtNaimFORu_qzQNX4r85VP3rVwcljJ_sZ6UoBnSjd-8JGRtG_3Mk--V1vMPrKaoRMUMFgOLqNqzHs-ynT0ALPF5BtYy1JA9dGx5CXrBDqr1oj-d_PB3NcOmjHkVUhYT7KY35tLuHwk5i__GdWyQxEg7MXetfjHLNL6Iq3nlQJupVwOtQkFpdAokljHZtxn1BD0D8dRaJxf2E2bmnnmRRqm8%3D)

They are celebrating early. And OH-15 is on their target list.

Here is what I know: the DCCC watches these mid-month numbers closely. A strong report from a targeted district tells them their confidence is misplaced here, that there is a funded, organized campaign waiting for them, and that this seat is going to cost them more than they planned. A weak one tells them the map is right and to pour it on.

But here is what matters most to me tonight: the grassroots. Not the PAC money. Fellow Patriot, I'll get right to it.

Our October 15th mid-month deadline hits at midnight, _and right now we're short of where we need to be._

Hi Pro-Life Friend,

As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip.

When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color.

That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters.

Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version.

And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Dear Pro-Life Friend, here's my problem.

You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism.

So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable.
That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races.

[Will you please chip in right now to keep our rapid response team ready to move the moment we get word of the next public event](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=9530eef00fec4e8ba6b2152afa0783bb&_e=hBV31tE0bqj8OlAc4gVSbT38UOABFiJoCZAhKRZ46x4wqwgEkXXpuVVbQAl3hIJGpua75_cYpOWUGtYz7cFYEVNwS7Fg3HluYkpmjaLvBTlqNk1egK5cP5JLbvFqJf_OFtJmViLIPrnSEdYa0VBE6iBwsysFroZHeAfIgblaPj3WibvDcNbd9ILrIMesYCcUmAiC8gifauuTKWjX0-PNEXBtFfT5seVtMwlGaw2cuo5QNG5xdNm8JqNSEqT1gQf21VZoI9vd4utwPQSSXmCVhgcSrjP7KudYFfZfpGvgDp9fAqcKQJYQtNbXOo8CN3CnwBryKGcQcqTisrmqjGe_ECJRO2xMZ8cltxQCwONbvxk4F3CkeFRDdAYi2loO4YUthkBEmS3hX9ZTuCbv-L6OJYn55sbaqn3r1UvwXUILv1Bby6-i8KbrhK4ppPeH4W4EH0k1l_yzYrS5dOhUd32k9KrFmaEjLGbF8L1C805zEPDhcNV3HqqOemYw--YrktSpARbuG4iwUvst-sLGVOsFRf1wCoOKYeQlDHX6f4lFbclMRJ3iN5b9KXzkKqq_-okvKqNq-kl5IinLZ67wO6n6cHsIxb2tmPei_P4bVtGiDciKIXI8_Av5bE2ajMjS6vGzcbHOF5UKOv93YH3etCi58g%3D%3D)**?**

Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard.

Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance.

Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it?

A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally."

I've seen it time and time again.

These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election.

One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle.

Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out.

So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after.

That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own.

None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline.

Survivors of the Abu Shandi drone strike at Ad-Damazin Teaching Hospital, in Blue Nile State, Sudan, on October 12, 2026. Photo by Eisa Dafalla.
AD-DAMAZIN, Sudan--On the morning of October 9, Ahmed Ragab Abu Shina, 39, joined dozens of other displaced people digging for gold in a seasonal riverbed, known locally as a _khor_ , near the Abu Shandi shelter in Sudan's Blue Nile State.
At around 9 a.m., a drone flew overhead from the south. No one knew whose it was, and no one thought it had come for them. Suddenly, an explosive shell landed in the middle of the _khor_ , where men, women and children were working side by side.
"After the shell fell, dozens went down, and whoever could flee fled," Ragab told Drop Site News. "In those moments, no one knew where their family members or relatives were."
The strike killed 32 displaced people--26 women, four children and two elderly people--and wounded 43 others, according to Dr. Mustafa Jabrallah, Blue Nile State's acting health minister.
Jabrallah blamed the drone strike on the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), a powerful paramilitary group that has been fighting the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) since April 2023, engulfing the country in what the United Nations [calls](https://substack.com/redirect/c7b93eb8-56f3-4e22-8a91-700f54c2279a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) "the world's worst health and humanitarian crisis."
The strike on the _khor_ in the Blue Nile State, in southeastern Sudan, is far from the RSF's strongholds of Darfur and Kordofan, but it has become an active front of the war. Though the SAF holds the key administrative centers of the region, including the state capital, Ad-Damazin, that control is being challenged by the RSF and its allied rebel group, Sudan People's Liberation Movement-North (SPLM-N). A recent RSF and SPLM-N attack on al-Hijra, a neighborhood north of Ad-Damazin, killed four women and wounded 13 others, Jabrallah said. Elsewhere, RSF and SPLM-N fighters have seized southeastern border areas like Geissan and Kurmuk. And the SPLM-N has long held or contested other pockets of the region.
In recent months, the two sides have been fighting over strategic towns and bases in southeastern Sudan, near the Ethiopian border, according to the[ UN](https://substack.com/redirect/ae9926c5-638c-4790-bc83-579c9a198390?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and sustained attacks have displaced thousands of people. The RSF has also pushed further into army-held territory.

The killing of 32 civilians at the Abu Shandi shelter last week was particularly devastating. In a [briefing](https://substack.com/redirect/ae9926c5-638c-4790-bc83-579c9a198390?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that same day, UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric condemned the "horrifying reports" of that attack and others on civilians, and called for those responsible to be held accountable.
In attacking the Abu Shandi camp, the Sudan Doctors Network [said](https://substack.com/redirect/9d37aa06-00ca-41e1-9012-7e26b6ed19cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the RSF committed "yet another crime in the ongoing pattern of violations against civilians in Sudan."
"Targeting gatherings of displaced persons with drones constitutes a war crime and a flagrant violation of international humanitarian law," the organization added.
A coalition of RSF and allied forces, the Sudan Founding Alliance, [denied](https://substack.com/redirect/51d15ebd-87f0-4d11-8117-5e092b61534b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) carrying out the attack. In a statement on Facebook, a spokesperson said that blaming the RSF for the strike amounted to making "fabricated and booby-trapped statements."
## **Violence Chasing the Displaced**
Like many others in the Abu Shandi camp, Ahmed Ragab fled Agro, an area in Geissan locality about 30 kilometers (19 miles) north of the town of Geissan and 140 kilometers (87 miles) south of Ad-Damazin, along with people displaced from Bakori, Geissan, Khor al-Dahab, and al-Jabalain to escape the RSF's advance. They had lived in safety and peace until what he called "the cursed war" reached them.
Abu Shandi was supposed to be safe, but once they arrived they struggled to find food. So they turned to a _khor_ near the shelter and began mining for gold in the traditional way, rinsing mud with water to recover grains of gold that they could sell to feed their families.
Buthaina Mohamed Teel Amer, 35, who is also from Agro, fled to Abu Shandi in August after fighting escalated when the RSF entered Kurmuk, a border town near Ad-Damazin.
Local aid workers gave plastic sheeting to the displaced people, so that they could build makeshift shelters, she said. They also handed out rations of a whole grain called sorghum--each ration weighed only about two kilograms. It was not enough to eat, so most of the displaced went to work in mining at the nearby riverbed to earn money for food.
On the day of the strike, Amer was in the _khor_ with members of her family when the drone dropped a shell into the crowd. Some of the surviving victims were burned so badly that their relatives could not recognize them and had to ask for their names to identify them. About 30 people died on the spot, she said.
"Everyone was screaming," Amer recalled. "As I searched for the wounded, I found human remains in the trees and in the water of the _khor_. Some of the injured lay in their own blood, crying out in pain."
Residents of Abu Shandi rushed to the site when they heard the blast, helping rescue the wounded and bury the dead. No government officials or emergency workers were present, Ragab said. Civilians handled the rescue themselves.
## **A War in Its Fourth Year**
In April 2023, four years after a popular uprising ousted longtime president Omar al-Bashir, fighting erupted across Sudan, when a power struggle escalated into open war between the SAF, led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, and the RSF, commanded by General Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, known as Hemedti.
At least 150,000 people have died since the war began, but some [estimates](https://substack.com/redirect/c07a7e44-bcbb-44a7-b5f1-93efec2a342b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are far higher. About 14 million people have been driven from their homes, including more than 4.5 million who have fled to neighboring countries--the single largest displacement crisis in the world. For those who have remained, starvation is acute. "More people are living in famine conditions in Sudan than the rest of the world combined," [according](https://substack.com/redirect/3a26be95-eaf5-4126-9234-748ba375f807?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to the International Rescue Committee.
In Blue Nile, the fighting is pushing people out again, locals told Drop Site News.
The RSF recently destroyed the main water source in Area 6 of Wad Al-Mahi, said Mahjoub al-Sheikh Al-Khalifa, commissioner of the locality, and its fighters stormed the al-Kadalo administrative unit, driving more than 8,000 people toward Roseires, a town north of Ad-Damazin. On October 11, Al-Khalifa said, the RSF struck and destroyed Um Darfa hospital in the locality.
Drones are now a central weapon for both sides, with strikes killing more than 1,100 people in the first five months of the year, according to UN figures.
Some of the heaviest attacks have come in fiercely contested areas like El-Obeid, the capital of North Kordofan. The SAF maintains control of the city while RSF forces have seized areas to the north, west and south. Over the span of just one week, between September 25 and October 1, RSF drones hit El-Obeid at least five times, according to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project. "Targets included a shelter at the Land Port, an events hall, the Sports City complex and Sheikan Dormitory. SAF air defenses intercepted drones on two of the days," ACLED said in a statement.
The strike on Sheikhan dormitory in Kordofan University, on September 30, was a double-tap suicide drone attack which killed five people, including two women and a child, and wounded 26, according to local emergency responders, who blamed the RSF.
## **Aid Under Fire**
In Abu Shandi, the wounded were carried on donkey carts, farm tractors, and stretchers to Area 6 of Wad Al-Mahi locality, Ragab said, before the most critical cases were moved to Ad-Damazin Teaching Hospital.
The condition of the wounded has improved now that medicine is available, he added, but families are forced to buy whatever the hospital or local aid groups do not provide for free. A bill for antibiotics, painkillers, and gauze in private pharmacies can reach 290,000 Sudanese pounds (around $35).
The government has so far offered them nothing, Amer said. At a public hospital with her 13-year-old daughter, Halima, who was wounded in the strike, she saw patients contending with swarms of mosquitoes that can carry dangerous diseases, she said. The government had not supplied the hospital with any protective nets.
The strike on the Abu Shandi shelter is part of a pattern of RSF attacks on civilians, Dr. Mohamed Faisal of the Sudan Doctors Network said. Its forces have systematically targeted shelters, displacement camps, aid convoys, hospitals and service centers.
"Drone strikes on civilian sites have become a constant of the war," he said. The RSF attacked a [kindergarten](https://substack.com/redirect/52402084-6f13-4470-a439-c04c55a13ba8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in South Kordofan state in December 2025, and a [shelter](https://substack.com/redirect/659af5a6-db64-4e78-859d-7aa30318ea5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in El Fasher two months earlier. These attacks have severely disrupted relief efforts for the displaced and now threaten the lives of humanitarian workers. "Several organizations have lost staff, and recent attacks on trucks carrying aid and on Red Crescent [workers](https://substack.com/redirect/eff29240-af55-43b5-b014-09ae33a7e250?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) show the dangers they face," he said.
Conditions in the shelters and camps are dire, he added. They lack basic services like food and medicine, and epidemics and diseases are spreading.
"We don't have accurate statistics, but we have no doubt that these epidemics and diseases, under the current conditions, will claim more lives," he said.
Al-Khalifa, the commissioner of Wad Al-Mahi, called on the international community to condemn the RSF's attacks, and asked for an independent, transparent investigation to identify those responsible for killing women and children in displacement shelters.
For Amer, the losses are counted in families. "Several girls were killed alongside their mothers," she said. "An entire family of eight was wiped out in the strike."

"Targeting gatherings of displaced persons with drones constitutes a war crime and a flagrant violation of international humanitarian law," the organization added. A coalition of RSF and allied forces, the Sudan Founding Alliance, carrying out the attack. In a statement on Facebook, a spokesperson said that blaming the RSF for the strike amounted to making "fabricated and booby-trapped statements." Violence Chasing the Displaced Like many others in the Abu Shandi camp, Ahmed Ragab fled Agro, an area in Geissan locality about 30 kilometers (19 miles) north of the town of Geissan and 140 kilometers (87 miles) south of Ad-Damazin, along with people displaced from Bakori, Geissan, Khor al-Dahab, and al-Jabalain to escape the RSF's advance. They had lived in safety and peace until what he called "the cursed war" reached them. Abu Shandi was supposed to be safe, but once they arrived they struggled to find food. So they turned to a khor near the shelter and began mining for gold in the traditional way, rinsing mud with water to recover grains of gold that they could sell to feed their families. Buthaina Mohamed Teel Amer, 35, who is also from Agro, fled to Abu Shandi in August after fighting escalated when the RSF entered Kurmuk, a border town near Ad-Damazin. Local aid workers gave plastic sheeting to the displaced people, so that they could build makeshift shelters, she said. They also handed out rations of a whole grain called sorghum--each ration weighed only about two kilograms. It was not enough to eat, so most of the displaced went to work in mining at the nearby riverbed to earn money for food. On the day of the strike, Amer was in the khor with members of her family when the drone dropped a shell into the crowd. Some of the surviving victims were burned so badly that their relatives could not recognize them and had to ask for their names to identify them. About 30 people died on the spot, she said. "Everyone was screaming," Amer recalled. "As I searched for the wounded, I found human remains in the trees and in the water of the khor. Some of the injured lay in their own blood, crying out in pain." Residents of Abu Shandi rushed to the site when they heard the blast, helping rescue the wounded and bury the dead. No government officials or emergency workers were present, Ragab said. Civilians handled the rescue themselves. A War in Its Fourth Year In April 2023, four years after a popular uprising ousted longtime president Omar al-Bashir, fighting erupted across Sudan, when a power struggle escalated into open war between the SAF, led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, and the RSF, commanded by General Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, known as Hemedti. At least 150,000 people have died since the war began, but some are far higher. About 14 million people have been driven from their homes, including more than 4.5 million who have fled to neighboring countries--the single largest displacement crisis in the world. For those who have remained, starvation is acute. "More people are living in famine conditions in Sudan than the rest of the world combined," to the International Rescue Committee. In Blue Nile, the fighting is pushing people out again, locals told Drop Site News. The RSF recently destroyed the main water source in Area 6 of Wad Al-Mahi, said Mahjoub al-Sheikh Al-Khalifa, commissioner of the locality, and its fighters stormed the al-Kadalo administrative unit, driving more than 8,000 people toward Roseires, a town north of Ad-Damazin. On October 11, Al-Khalifa said, the RSF struck and destroyed Um Darfa hospital in the locality. Drones are now a central weapon for both sides, with strikes killing more than 1,100 people in the first five months of the year, according to UN figures. Some of the heaviest attacks have come in fiercely contested areas like El-Obeid, the capital of North Kordofan. The SAF maintains control of the city while RSF forces have seized areas to the north, west and south. Over the span of just one week, between September 25 and October 1, RSF drones hit El-Obeid at least five times, according to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data (ACLED) project. "Targets included a shelter at the Land Port, an events hall, the Sports City complex and Sheikan Dormitory. SAF air defenses intercepted drones on two of the days," ACLED said in a statement. The strike on Sheikhan dormitory in Kordofan University, on September 30, was a double-tap suicide drone attack which killed five people, including two women and a child, and wounded 26, according to local emergency responders, who blamed the RSF. Aid Under Fire In Abu Shandi, the wounded were carried on donkey carts, farm tractors, and stretchers to Area 6 of Wad Al-Mahi locality, Ragab said, before the most critical cases were moved to Ad-Damazin Teaching Hospital. The condition of the wounded has improved now that medicine is available, he added, but families are forced to buy whatever the hospital or local aid groups do not provide for free. A bill for antibiotics, painkillers, and gauze in private pharmacies can reach 290,000 Sudanese pounds (around $35). The government has so far offered them nothing, Amer said. At a public hospital with her 13-year-old daughter, Halima, who was wounded in the strike, she saw patients contending with swarms of mosquitoes that can carry dangerous diseases, she said. The government had not supplied the hospital with any protective nets. The strike on the Abu Shandi shelter is part of a pattern of RSF attacks on civilians, Dr. Mohamed Faisal of the Sudan Doctors Network said. Its forces have systematically targeted shelters, displacement camps, aid convoys, hospitals and service centers. "Drone strikes on civilian sites have become a constant of the war," he said. The RSF attacked a in South Kordofan state in December 2025, and a in El Fasher two months earlier. These attacks have severely disrupted relief efforts for the displaced and now threaten the lives of humanitarian workers. "Several organizations have lost staff, and recent attacks on trucks carrying aid and on Red Crescent show the dangers they face," he said. Conditions in the shelters and camps are dire, he added. They lack basic services like food and medicine, and epidemics and diseases are spreading. "We don't have accurate statistics, but we have no doubt that these epidemics and diseases, under the current conditions, will claim more lives," he said. Al-Khalifa, the commissioner of Wad Al-Mahi, called on the international community to condemn the RSF's attacks, and asked for an independent, transparent investigation to identify those responsible for killing women and children in displacement shelters. For Amer, the losses are counted in families. "Several girls were killed alongside their mothers," she said. "An entire family of eight was wiped out in the strike." Here's why I'm writing to you specifically:

**In the last month,_six_ _separate polls_ have shown me leading Greg Abbott in the race for Governor.**
Abbott had never been shown trailing in a public poll before last month — in any race he’s ever run. In twelve years and three campaigns for governor, Abbott has never faced anything like this.
But here's what worries me: **Tomorrow night is our final mid-month fundraising deadline before the election.**
_**This is the moment when your support in this race matters most, Peter.**_
**That’s why we set a goal to raise $3 million before the October 16th mid-month deadline. This is the minimum amount of money we need to raise, and falling short is not an option. As of writing this email, we’re 93.6% of the way there.**
According to our records, you haven't had the chance to chip in yet this month, and I wanted to make sure you heard about where we stand from me before the deadline passes.
Here's what I want you to understand about timing: This race is a real toss-up, and the window where your grassroots donation can help us hold onto our lead is _right now._

name: Aaron Day
subject: Tonight: I cost the GOP three seats in 2016. Now 8 more.
body:
# THE AARON DAY SHOW
Defending Free Will in the Age of Technocracy
S3E27 • Oct 15
## Semafor: I Cost the GOP a Senate Seat. Now I'm Doing It to 8 More.
[ ](https://us.list-manage.com/I5yIEHMhdV0?e=938a87a89b&c2id=c1b996ddd6cdaaf4cddb384f099ac837)
Semafor calls a third party polling at a few points a rounding error.
That rounding error decides Senate seats.
I know because I have done it. In 2016 I ran for US Senate in New Hampshire and recruited the third-party candidates in the state's other two federal races, NH-1 and NH-2. Republicans lost all three seats, and in all three our vote was bigger than the margin: Senate, 17,742 votes against a 1,017-vote margin; NH-1, 34,735 against 4,904; NH-2, 17,088 against 15,522. New Hampshire has not sent a Republican to Congress since, the first time since 1854. Semafor ran the story. Tonight I lay out how StarkFreedom PAC does it again in eight states.
Here is our latest map. There are eight Senate races: Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, New Hampshire, Ohio, South Carolina and Texas. In four of them (Iowa, Kansas, Ohio and Texas), the third-party share in the polls already covers the gap between the two parties. In Michigan and New Hampshire it does not cover the gap yet. Minnesota and South Carolina do not have enough polling to call.
Four of eight. I will put every poll on screen with its source.
GOP operatives, this one is for you. We are not asking you to behave. We are showing you how it works, with a date on it and in public, so nobody can say later that they were not warned. We fund the margin, and that costs the GOP the Senate.
Liberty voters, this is what it looks like when the party stops taking your vote for granted. The PAC is the lever. It is not the prize. A party that keeps ignoring you pays for it on election night.
Ernie Hancock joins me. I am holding one number back for the live show.
TONIGHT: Thursday, October 15, 6:00 PM ET. Live on YouTube, Rumble and X.
Watch it, clip it and send it to the one Republican staffer you know. Then back the work at starkfreedom.org.

Minnesota and South Carolina do not have enough polling to call. Four of eight. I will put every poll on screen with its source. GOP operatives, this one is for you. We are not asking you to behave. We are showing you how it works, with a date on it and in public, so nobody can say later that they were not warned. We fund the margin, and that costs the GOP the Senate. Liberty voters, this is what it looks like when the party stops taking your vote for granted. The PAC is the lever. It is not the prize. A party that keeps ignoring you pays for it on election night. Ernie Hancock joins me. I am holding one number back for the live show. TONIGHT: Thursday, October 15, 6:00 PM ET. Live on YouTube, Rumble and X. Watch it, clip it and send it to the one Republican staffer you know. Then back the work at starkfreedom.org. TODAY'S TOP STORIES

WHAT’S ON YOUR 2026 COLORADO BALLOT: ALL NINE FEDERAL RACES
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

Every one of Colorado’s eight seats in the U.S. House is on the
ballot this November, along with one of the state’s two U.S. Senate
seats. Eight of those nine races feature an incumbent seeking another
term. The lone open House seat, Denver’s 1st District, has no
incumbent for the first time in 30 years.

Candidates are listed from the official list the Secretary of State
certified to the counties on Sept. 4. A note on sourcing. Platform
items are the candidate’s own wording, with the source named at the
end of each line.

Endorsements are the organizations each campaign lists on its own
site, plus President Trump, whose backing is itself news in these
races. Individual endorsers are omitted for space, and nearly every
candidate has them.

Rocky Mountain Voice has not confirmed every listing, and campaigns
sometimes carry endorsements forward from prior elections. “None
listed” means no organization appears on that candidate’s own
site, not that none exists.

[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

KERBER: AREN’T WE TAXED ENOUGH ALREADY?
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

BY DAVE KERBER, ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE
[https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.

_With statewide measures and dozens of local tax hikes on the 2026
ballot, a former Greenwood Village council member argues Colorado’s
governmental entities are in a tax-increase feeding frenzy._

*
STATEWIDE MEASURES ADD UP TO BILLIONS: Proposition NN would eventually
raise taxes by $5 billion annually by bypassing TABOR limits,
Proposition 137 redirects up to $175 million by moving existing sales
tax revenue into a special fund, and Amendment 87’s graduated income
tax would pull an additional $2 billion from the economy while also
escaping TABOR caps.

*
A NEW RAILROAD FUNDED BY A SALES TAX HIKE: The proposed Front Range
Rail (CoCo) would require a 0.33% sales tax increase projected to cost
taxpayers $295 million next year, growing over time, to fund a rail
line the author argues won’t draw enough riders to cover its own
costs.

*
LOCAL TAX REQUESTS STACK ON TOP: The piece tallies dozens of local
measures, including Denver, Jefferson County, Littleton and Douglas
County school mill levy overrides serving fewer students, plus sales
and property tax hikes from Larimer County, Aurora, Centennial,
Boulder and multiple fire districts, arguing combined local and state
increases make the affordability crisis worse rather than better.

name: Troy Jackson
subject: We can’t eat road salt, Peter
body:
|
#
| | | | | Hi, Peter – Roy Cooper here. My friend Troy Jackson is running for U.S. Senate in Maine, and he needs our support. If you can, [**_I hope you'll split a donation between our grassroots campaigns._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19797?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1608&amount=5&t=7&akid=4604%2E124072%2EFqT7af)

If you'd no longer like to receive these partner emails, [**_you can opt out here._**](https://act.roycooper.com/signup/unsub-tandems/?t=8&akid=4604%2E124072%2EFqT7af)
---|---
Peter, here's the deal.**
Susan Collins really knows how to put on a show in the Senate.
She votes with Trump 96% of the time. If she knows one of his bad bills is going to tank, she’ll vote against it. If she’s the deciding vote, she’ll always vote for it, just like how she was the deciding vote for Brett Kavanaugh, who then overturned _Roe v. Wade._
The same is also true with Trump’s tariffs. Mainers and folks across the country are hurting badly from rising costs – and too many families are having to pick between picking up their prescriptions or putting food on the table.
So when she said during our debate that she brought down the cost of road salt, **I had to say what shouldn’t need to be said:**
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19797?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1608&amount=5&t=9&akid=4604%2E124072%2EFqT7af)
It goes to show just how out of touch Susan is with families across Maine. Road salt isn’t going to make groceries, heating oil, or everyday necessities affordable again.
Susan Collins is so used to putting the needs of billionaires over her constituents. I’m running to defeat her because folks across Maine have made me into the public servant I am today, and they deserve a Senator who isn’t afraid to take on tough battles.
**But poll after poll shows me tied with Susan Collins, and she’s spending double what we are on TV ads. We need to pick up the pace if we want any shot at flipping this seat and retaking the Senate majority for Democrats.**
[**_So Peter, will you please split $5 – or more, if you can spare it – between my campaign and Roy Cooper right now? I refuse to take a dime from corporate PACs (unlike Susan), so I can’t run my campaign without folks like you chipping in._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/19797?refcode=email_bu_pros_jtk1608&amount=5&t=10&akid=4604%2E124072%2EFqT7af)

I’m endlessly grateful for your support.
Let’s win.
– Troy

name: True the Vote
subject: Someone you know needs a reason to show up and vote
body:
How many people in your life would listen if you said, “This matters”?
| | [](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0)
---
Someone you know needs a reason to show up and vote. Give them one. Dear friend, How many people in your life would take a call from you, read your text, or listen when you said, _“This matters”_? Your sister. A neighbor. A friend from church. Someone who’s frustrated enough to sit this election out. You can’t make their decisions for them. But you can remind them that their voice matters—and help them make a plan to use it. That’s why we built [7 Votes](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0). It’s a simple, free way to turn “somebody should do something” into something each of us can do. Pick seven people you know. Each day, [7 Votes](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0) gives you a short message you can send in seconds. Your friends get a link to check their registration, make a voting plan, and follow through.
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0)
A little encouragement. A practical next step. From someone they trust. You don’t need a platform or a big following. You already have a place to start. And people are starting.
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0)
Those numbers represent people reaching into their own circles and saying, “Let’s do our part.” Every invitation is a chance to bring someone into the process who might otherwise sit it out. Help us keep it growing. [7 Votes](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0) is free, and we intend to keep it that way. We don’t sell personal information, collect contact lists, or ask how anyone votes. But building and running these tools takes resources. That’s where your support makes a difference. Your gift helps us keep voting information and reminders moving, support new organizers, and put [7 Votes](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0) in more hands before November 3. **Will you give $25, $50, $100—or whatever you can—to help us reach the next seven, and the seven after that?**
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/8ghqhoho8e9ko6skh9/aHR0cHM6Ly9kb25hdGUudHR2bm93Lm9yZy8=)
Election Day is Tuesday, November 3. What we do between now and then matters. Think of the person who means to vote but keeps putting off making a plan. The friend who’s discouraged. The family member who wonders whether one vote makes any difference. **Reach out. Make it personal. Follow through.** We work every day to protect the vote. Together, let’s make sure people use it. Thank you for helping us turn encouragement to action! Keep the faith! Never quit! Ephesians 6 FTW! Ever onward—
The [7 Votes](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0) Team
A project of True the Vote Now
[](https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/qdunm92pw8f7h4xeq02tlh88lrdpoi4hkovx9/reh8hohmp9xnmzi2h6/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3JnL3N0YXJ0)

Gifts made through this email go to True the Vote Now and are not tax deductible as charitable contributions. **True the Vote** is a 501(c)(3) charitable nonprofit (EIN 27-2860095). Gifts to True the Vote are tax deductible to the extent allowed by law. True the Vote and True the Vote Now are separate, affiliated organizations, both founded and led by Catherine Engelbrecht and her team. As we enter this final stretch, I’m making my pitch to Virginians, asking them to hire me one more time.

[_**But before I lay out my pitch for my next term, I’m asking you to chip in to this campaign today and help us finish out the final 19 days before Election Day strong >>**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497259/653753414/-977686964?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=)

So here it is – my closing argument to voters:

**One, we’ve got to end this grifting coming out of Washington – and actually get something done to lower costs for Americans.**

When Donald Trump personally profits by over $2 billion while his policies cause prices to skyrocket for everyday Virginians...

... That’s not just wrong. That’s corruption on steroids.

I’m leading the fight to hold Donald Trump accountable, take on those in Washington who are profiting off hardworking taxpayers, and actually get something done to lower costs.

**Two, we need to move past the partisan fights over Obamacare, and toward a system of universal coverage.**

I helped write the Affordable Care Act, which massively expanded health care access and protected people with preexisting conditions, and I’ve worked to strengthen it ever since.

But it’s become clear to me that we need universal health care coverage to finally bring down costs for everyone and ensure every American can access a basic standard of care.

**Three, we need to act FAST to address the challenges artificial intelligence presents to our country and to our workforce.**

Artificial intelligence is going to transform virtually every sector of our economy, and we are nowhere near prepared for what that means for American workers, our national security, and our children’s health and safety.

We need to act now, and AI companies and big corporations that stand to massively profit must do their part, including preparing workers and paying their fair share of the enormous energy demands AI will place on our energy grid.

**The challenges facing our country right now are big. There’s no doubt about that.**

But I still believe that a better way forward is possible.

I first got into public service for one basic reason: Where you start should never determine where you end up.

That’s what this campaign is about – and that’s what’s at stake at the ballot box in just a few weeks.

[_**Will you chip in today and make sure we win this race and continue making progress on the issues that matter most?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497260/653753415/-977686964?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=)

Let’s get this done – together.

Thank you,

Mark Warner **Before you go:**

We are officially in the final, all-out sprint towards Election Day – and we can’t afford to take our foot off the gas.

Victory in November requires sustained engagement from grassroots supporters like you. Right now, this campaign is recruiting volunteers, getting our ads up on the airwaves, and scaling our Get Out the Vote operation.

**You can join our efforts by[ _signing up to volunteer with Virginia Democrats_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497261/653753416/45988322?utm_source=mw_email_footerb&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=&emci=a82a33ed-b9c8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=a51dca68-cdc8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=4568237) or [_chipping in to fund our critical voter outreach efforts._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497262/653753417/-977686964?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=)** ********[Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497263/653753418/-977686964?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=)****************[VOLUNTEER](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141497264/653753419/45988322?utm_source=mw_email_footer&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FinalPitch_261015_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNTFkY2E2OC1jZGM4LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TpTPX0ek7-SQvn6DfRc3Pd5jezvX2Y863PY-G1JM1ZM=&emci=a82a33ed-b9c8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&emdi=a51dca68-cdc8-f111-bf5b-000d3a4fbe83&ceid=4568237)********

clean_body: | | | Peter, When asked about AIPAC during last Thursday’s Michigan Senate debate, Mike Rogers said that “anybody that wants to help my campaign stop [Abdul El-Sayed], I’ll take all of that help.”1 Within 24 hours, AIPAC’s super PAC suddenly started spending again on attack ads against our WFP champion. 2 We’ll never be able to outspend AIPAC and MAGA donors. But we can out-organize them. We were able to overcome the $70 million that they spent against Abdul in the primary, and we’ll do it against Mike Rogers too. But we need resources to power our canvasses and phonebanks. This will be one of our biggest challenges of the year. Throughout all of 2026, we’ve proven that working class families are hungry for a new kind of political power to take hold. And we’ve overcome record-breaking spending from the billionaire class to get to this point. But Abdul is AIPAC’s #1 target. Experts think that more than $300 million will be spent in this race by November 3rd.3 We need to knock doors and talk to voters all day, every day, in order to overcome the amount of advertising we’re up against. And to do that, we need two things: money and volunteers. Thanks for all that you’ve done during these midterms. Let’s finish strong. # We Need Your Help in These Final Weeks
---
Election Day is less than three weeks away, and we're entering one of the most important stretches of this campaign.
Over the past year, I've traveled thousands of miles across South Dakota, meeting with voters, listening to their concerns, and sharing my vision for what our state deserves from its representative in Congress. We've put in the miles, built relationships, and had conversations in communities across the state.
But there are still South Dakotans we need to reach before November 3.
That's why we're making a final investment in advertising, voter outreach, and getting our message in front of as many people as possible. Every additional dollar we raise helps us reach more voters in these final weeks.
I'm asking you to make a contribution today to help us finish this campaign with the resources we need. Your support will make a difference in what we're able to accomplish between now and Election Day.
We've worked too hard and come too far to slow down now. I'm ready to give everything I've got over these final weeks, and I'm asking you to help us make the most of every day we have left.
Thank you for being part of this campaign.
Nikki

---

We visited coffee shops, a hospital, wacipi, livestock auction, and Main Streets. We knocked on doors, delivered yard signs, and had conversations with Republicans, Independents, and Democrats.

Over the past year, I've traveled thousands of miles across South Dakota, meeting with voters, listening to their concerns, and sharing my vision for what our state deserves from its representative in Congress. We've put in the miles, built relationships, and had conversations in communities across the state. But there are still South Dakotans we need to reach before November 3. That's why we're making a final investment in advertising, voter outreach, and getting our message in front of as many people as possible. Every additional dollar we raise helps us reach more voters in these final weeks. I'm asking you to make a contribution today to help us finish this campaign with the resources we need. Your support will make a difference in what we're able to accomplish between now and Election Day. We've worked too hard and come too far to slow down now. Fellow American,

I am not going to sugarcoat this.

We are less than a month from the midterms, the Senate is closer than it should be, and Chuck Schumer wakes up every single morning believing he is going to take this majority from us.

I have spent my career fighting for the Constitution, the border, and the agenda that President Trump was elected to deliver. I have been in the room when the left tried to stop us at every turn. I know exactly what a Democrat Senate majority looks like — and I am telling you right now, we cannot let it happen.

**_Here is what Schumer does on day one with a Senate Majority, Fellow American:_**

* He kills every judicial nomination in the pipeline. The originalist judges, the constitutional conservatives who will shape American law for a generation — **_gone._**
* He reopens the border. Every enforcement mechanism, every executive action, every policy that has slowed the invasion at our southern border becomes a political target.

The pretext is a baseless smear about her immigration history that Trump's movement has peddled for years. I spent 20 years in uniform defending this country from regimes that pull stunts like this. The dawn raid on a political opponent is the signature move of every despot on earth, and I am angered beyond words watching it happen in the country I served. Omar is an American citizen, a former refugee, and an elected member of Congress. Trump spent years saying she should be jailed or shipped back to Somalia, told rally crowds to chant "send her back," and called her "garbage." Now his agents are kicking in her door over his grievance, with no evidence anyone has shown the public. Meanwhile, this administration has conducted zero raids and zero arrests connected to the Epstein files, a provable, documented international child trafficking ring stocked with connected elites. They have released barely half the pages. Mike Johnson sent the entire House home rather than allow a vote on the rest, and Keith Self stood with that blockade every step. Ken Paxton's office even set a predator free. Protect the predators, punish the refugees. That is the extremist agenda now. And this moral rot runs all the way down to the rallies. This week, Trump supporters physically assaulted a woman whose shirt asked for one thing: the release of the Epstein files. The party that claims to protect women and children beat a woman demanding a pedophile ring face the law. I did not fly combat missions so America could become the extremism I fought. Despots raid their critics and protect the powerfully corrupt. Free countries read the evidence and protect the innocent, whoever they are and wherever they were born. Keith Self chose the cover-up and the cruelty. In 19 days, this district chooses better.
